title: Digital Creative Services Manager
description:
Location: Hybrid or Remote (depending on location)

Join 4ocean and advance your career while making a significant impact on the environment.



About Us:

4ocean is on a mission to end the ocean plastic crisis and we are looking for passionate, talented people to help us achieve this goal.  We are more than just a brand/company/employer. We are a global movement committed to making a tangible difference in the health of our planet by removing plastic waste from the ocean and coastlines. We also advocate for sustainable change. 

If you are driven by purpose, motivated to contribute to a cause that truly matters, and eager to make a lasting impact on the environment, we want you on our team.



Position Overview:

The Digital Creative Services Manager is a hands-on creative leader responsible for defining and executing the visual identity of our product line content across eCommerce and Wholesale channels blending creative design with marketing strategy. 

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, Product, this role sits at the intersection of brand storytelling, digital marketing, and product presentation. You’ll manage a Graphic Designer and serve as the creative authority on all product content — from the imagery that drives online conversion to the sell sheets and packaging that move product through wholesale partners.

This is a role best suited for someone who thinks strategically, executes precisely, and cares deeply about the mission behind the work.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Leadership & Strategy

•      Own the creative vision for all product content across eCommerce and Wholesale, ensuring brand consistency and mission alignment at every touchpoint.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements. Brand standards don’t drift on this person’s watch.

•    Leads production of both static and video assets, from concept through delivery.

•    Owns creative direction across all digital channels: paid social (Meta, TikTok), Amazon,
, DTC site, and any emerging placements.

•    Act as the operational infrastructure behind the creative. Build and maintain a creative asset library and production workflow, including naming conventions, version control, delivery specs by platform.

•     Partner with the Managing Director, Product to translate business goals into compelling visual narratives.

•     Establish and maintain brand guidelines for product content, photography direction, and digital design standards.

•     Stay ahead of digital design trends, platform algorithm changes, and wholesale presentation best practices.

eCommerce Content

•     Oversee the creation of all product listing assets including primary images, lifestyle photography, infographics, and A+ / enhanced content.

•     Optimize visual content for conversion across owned DTC channels and third-party platforms (e.g., Amazon, retail partner portals).

•     Collaborate with the eCommerce and marketing teams to develop campaign creative, landing pages, and promotional assets.

•     Analyze content performance data and iterate on creative strategy accordingly.

•    Manage multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.



Wholesale Content

•     Develop and maintain a suite of wholesale-facing materials including line sheets, sell sheets, trade show assets, and retail display concepts.

•     Ensure product photography and specifications meet the requirements of key wholesale partners and retail buyers.

•     Support seasonal product launches with tailored wholesale creative packages.

Team Management

•     Directly manage and mentor the Graphic Designer, providing clear briefs, constructive feedback, and professional development support.

•     Build and manage a freelance network (photographers, videographers, editors, etc) as needed for campaign productions.

•     Prioritize and manage the creative workload across projects, balancing quality with speed-to-market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

•     Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to ensure creative assets are aligned with product roadmaps and go-to-market timelines.

•     Partner with the eCommerce team on UX/UI creative decisions that support the online shopping experience.

•     Brief and manage external agencies or production vendors when applicable.

•     Partner directly with paid media to close the feedback loop.

•    Direct internal creators and any external agency or freelance talent. Clear briefing, sharp feedback, no ambiguity about what good looks like.

•    Manages multiple concurrent production cycles without dropping handoffs. Product launches, seasonal campaigns, evergreen content, and paid creative tests all run in parallel.

•    Interface with paid media, organic social,
, and wholesale channels as needed. Cross-functional by default, not by exception.



It’s also important that all 4ocean crew members naturally live and embrace our core values:

● Ocean first

● Get Shit Done!

● Accelerate time

● We’re in this together

● Nudge don’t judge

● Stay stoked

● Think bigger!



Qualifications:

Required

•     Minimum 5 years of experience in digital creative, brand design, or content production, with at least 2 years in a management or lead role.

•     Demonstrated experience creating product content for eCommerce platforms (DTC and/or marketplace).

•     Strong portfolio showcasing product photography direction, digital design, and brand-consistent visual storytelling.

•     Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and familiarity with Figma or similar tools.

•     Experience briefing and directing photographers, videographers, or other creative vendors.

•     Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

•     Knows the difference between a scroll-stopping hook frame and a pretty image that converts nobody.

•     Brand standards don’t drift on your watch.

•    You’re not a passenger on the analytics side. You read performance data (ie. CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop, ROAS by creative) and act on it.

•    Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects) and Figma. Working fluency in generative AI tools (Midjourney, Firefly, or equivalent) is not optional. PXM software is a plus.

•    You understand the authenticity of mission-first content architecture.

Preferred

•      Background in consumer goods, sustainability, outdoor, or lifestyle brands.

•      Experience with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms.

•      Familiarity with retail buyer presentation formats and wholesale portal requirements.

•      Passion for ocean conservation or environmental causes.

title: YouTube Documentary Video Editor (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
This is a long-term position with opportunities for raises and performance bonuses based on quality, reliability, turnaround time, and channel growth.



Please include your expected monthly salary in your application. Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates who fit our current budget.



Expected Workload

We are looking for an editor who can consistently edit approximately 4–8 long-form videos per month.

The exact workload may vary depending on channel needs.



About Us

We operate multiple faceless YouTube channels focused on:



- History

- Forgotten Wealth

- Dark Economics

- Geopolitics

- Forbidden Commodities

- Business History

- Documentary Storytelling



We are looking for a skilled editor who understands viewer retention and can transform a script and voice-over into an engaging documentary-style video.



Important

This position is not for basic video editing. We are looking for editors who can create engaging documentary-style videos by combining storytelling, research, footage sourcing, graphics, music, and pacing.



What We Provide



For each video, we will provide:

- Complete script

- Voice-over recording

- Reference YouTube video(s)

- Creative direction and feedback



Your Responsibilities

- Edit high-retention YouTube videos (10–60 minutes)

- Source relevant stock footage, photos, maps, graphics, animations, and B-roll

- Add text, motion graphics, zooms, transitions, and visual storytelling elements

- Select appropriate background music and sound effects

- Follow the editing style of our reference videos

- Deliver projects on schedule

- Revise videos based on feedback when necessary



Requirements

- Strong experience editing YouTube videos

- Excellent storytelling and pacing skills

- Ability to keep viewers engaged throughout long-form content

- Proficiency with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

- Ability to independently source visuals and assets

- Reliable communication and attention to detail

- Good English comprehension



Preferred Experience

Experience editing videos similar to:

- MagnatesMedia

- RealLifeLore

- Johnny Harris

- Fern

- Wendover Productions

- Search Party

- Modern MBA



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



To confirm you have read this entire job posting:



1. Include the word ATLAS as the second line of your application.

2. Record a short 30–60 second Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit for this position.

3. Answer all application questions below.

Applications that do not follow these instructions will be automatically rejected.

Application Questions

4. Send links to your 3 best YouTube videos that you personally edited and explain your role in each project.

5. Which editing software do you use?

6. How many years of YouTube editing experience do you have?

7. Have you edited documentary, history, business, or storytelling channels before?

8. If I provide only a script and voice-over, can you source all footage, images, maps, and graphics yourself? Please explain your process.

9. What YouTube channels inspire your editing style?

10. How many 15–30 minute documentary videos can you realistically edit per month?

11. How many hours per week are available?

12. What is your internet speed?

13. What monthly compensation are you seeking?



Final Selection Process

To be considered for this position, shortlisted applicants will be required to complete a 60-second sample edit using a script, voice-over recording, and reference video that we provide.



The purpose of this test is to evaluate:

- Storytelling ability

- Editing style

- Visual sourcing skills

- Pacing and viewer retention

- Sound design

- Attention to detail

- Ability to follow instructions



Please do not apply if you are unwilling to complete the sample edit.

Due to the volume of applications, only candidates selected for the next stage will receive the test materials.



Long-Term Opportunity

We are building multiple YouTube channels and are looking for a reliable editor to grow with us long-term.

Strong performers will receive:

- Higher monthly compensation

- Performance bonuses

- Additional editing projects

- Opportunities to work across multiple channels

If you are passionate about creating engaging documentary-style YouTube content, we would love to hear from you.

title: Podcast video editor
description:
Role Overview

You will own end-to-end video post-production for a weekly interview podcast. You will take raw multi-track

recordings and deliver a polished long-form episode, a podcast-ready audio file, and a set of vertical short-form

clips.

This is a role for an editor who works fluently with AI-assisted tools but brings real editorial judgment about pacing,

cuts, and what makes a moment land. The client is early in the show's life and actively developing their visual style,

so the first several episodes involve close collaboration and iteration. Your taste will shape the direction of the

show.



Responsibilities

Long-Form Editing

• Edit raw multi-track recordings into a polished episode, typically 30 minutes in length

• Build a clean side-by-side or multi-angle layout from separate host and guest video and audio tracks

• Remove filler, dead air, false starts, and tangents while preserving natural conversational flow

• Apply color correction and visual smoothing for a consistent look across episodes



Audio Production

• Perform audio cleanup, levelling, and noise reduction across separate speaker tracks

• Handle variable guest audio quality, since guests record remotely on their own equipment

• Deliver a podcast-ready audio file suitable for distribution



Short-Form Editing

• Cut 3 to 5 vertical clips per episode for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok

• Select moments with genuine standalone hook value rather than arbitrary segments

• Add clean, accurate captions and simple text treatments consistent with brand style



Collaboration and Workflow

• Work from a shared Riverside and Google Drive folder structure with clear stage gates

• Receive batched revision notes through 
 and turn them around cleanly in a single pass

• Stay reachable on the client's team channel for quick questions

• Help build and maintain a style and preferences document as feedback patterns emerge across the first month



Tools

• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve for primary editing

• AI-assisted clipping and transcription tools, used with editorial oversight

• Riverside for source recordings and transcripts

• 
 for review and feedback

• Google Drive and Google Workspace



Required Skills

• Two or more years editing long-form interview or talking-head video content

• Demonstrated short-form vertical editing with a clear sense of what holds attention

• Strong audio editing skills, particularly recovering usable audio from imperfect remote recordings

• Fluency with AI-assisted editing tools, paired with the judgment to recognize and override weak automated

output

• Reliable, organized file management and consistent turnaround against a batch workflow

• Strong written and spoken English for direct collaboration with the client team

• Comfortable receiving detailed creative feedback during an iterative early phase



Nice to Have

• Motion graphics and animated caption or transition work

• Thumbnail and still graphic design

• YouTube publishing, metadata, and SEO familiarity

• Multi-camera in-person production experience

• Background in e-commerce, creator economy, or B2B software content

title: Ecommerce Operations Assistant (Shopify / TikTok Shop)
description:
The company

A profitable, growing US-based specialty Tea Subscription ecommerce brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders) selling through Shopify, TikTok Shop, and a subscription program, with international warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU. The store operations side of the business is run by one teammate who is moving to a technical lead role, you'll be his right hand.



The role

You take the store operational work off the Technical Lead's plate so he can build. This is execution, monitoring, and data maintenance work, done reliably and precisely. You are not making purchasing decisions or writing code. You ARE the person who makes sure listings are right, inventory data is current, orders are tracked, and nothing falls through the cracks.

This role is also a growth path: the brand runs custom-built software and an AI agent for inventory intelligence. Start with the basics done flawlessly, and you'll be trained into the more complex systems.



What you'll do



Product listings and administration (Shopify + TikTok Shop)

-Create draft product listings from provided info: photos, videos, descriptions, SKUs, tags, collections, pricing

-Keep Shopify and TikTok Shop listings matched and in sync

-Audit listings for missing images, broken info, wrong tags; prep new listings for final review

-Handle backend product work: tagging, pricing updates, bundle linking (the brand has many SKUs and complex bundles)



Purchasing data maintenance

-Maintain the buying table used for purchasing coordination with the overseas team

-Log ordered products, tag in-transit inventory in the forecasting tool (Prediko), update incoming quantities

-Flag missing or inconsistent data. Buying decisions stay with the Technical Lead and sourcing team; your job is making sure the data they d
 from is right

-Inventory, orders, and fulfillment monitoring

-Routine checks on warehouse/fulfillment status and shipment tracking across Shopify, OMS, and spreadsheets

-Flag unresolved orders instead of letting them sit



Website support and QA

-Handle simple Shopify/website requests from the Customer Service team: text, images, FAQs, links, product settings

-Run checklist-based testing after site changes; test customer-facing scenarios, document issues with screenshots and repro steps, escalate anything technical



Task hygiene

-Keep Asana organized: statuses updated, stale tasks flagged, follow-ups chased



What you need

Hands-on Shopify admin experience (listings, products, collections, basic settings). TikTok Shop experience is a strong plus

Precise, reliable, detail-obsessed. This role is 80% "did it get done correctly, every time"

Comfortable in spreadsheets and matching data across systems

Smart enough to learn custom internal software. You don't need to code; you need to not be scared of new tools

Genuinely curious about AI tools: open, playful, and safe with them. You'll eventually work alongside an AI inventory agent

Strong written English; you'll coordinate with the Customer Service team and document issues clearly

title: Crypto BD Team Lead | DeFi Partnerships & Qualified Appointment Setting  Crypto BD Lead
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

description:
AI Video Editor — Meta Ads



Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $500 – $1000 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus every time one of your videos becomes a winner we scale.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your reel — we will not review an application without work to watch.



What the job is



We run supplement brands and we advertise on
 every single day. Our best-performing ads are AI-generated video: VSLs built from a script, carried by B-roll we generate ourselves.



We have the scripts. We have the system. We need the person who turns a script into a finished Meta ad, every day, using Higgsfield and Google Flow.



Your work



1. Turn the script into a finished VSL.

You get a written script — hook, problem, mechanism, offer. You produce the video that delivers it: generated scenes, voiceover, cuts, captions, sound. Finished ad, ready to upload.



2. Generate the B-roll that carries each beat.

The script says "most people take three supplements a day" — you produce the shot that shows it. You write the prompts in Higgsfield and Google Flow, you generate, and you keep the look consistent from scene to scene: same lighting, same product, same world.



3. Regenerate until it matches.

The first output is never the one. You see what is off — the hands, the label, the timing, the lighting — you fix the prompt and go again. This is most of the craft.



4. Cut it for Meta.

The first three seconds d
 everything. You feel it when a cut lands one beat too slow. Correct dimensions, correct length, caption style, naming convention — every time, no interpretation.



5. Deliver a batch every day, and apply the notes.

You send the day's videos for review, you get revision notes back, you apply them the same day and resend. This loop is the job.



6. Log everything.

Every video archived with a unique name and the prompts that made it. We must be able to re-cut or rebuild any winner months later without starting from scratch.



What we need from you

You have made AI video before, with Higgsfield or Google Flow. Kling, Veo or Runway also count. You already know the first generation is rarely usable.

You can edit properly. CapCut, Premiere or After Effects — pacing, captions, sound design, clean exports.

You understand what makes an ad hold attention. A VSL is not a montage. It builds.

You follow the format exactly. Dimensions, length, captions, naming. Not open to interpretation.

Written English good enough to work from our scripts and answer our revision notes.

Extremely organised. Files, versions, prompts, archives.

You deliver every single day. This is volume with a rhythm, not one masterpiece a month.

Nice to have



ElevenLabs or any voice cloning. UGC-style ads. Direct response video — VSLs, advertorials.
 Ads Manager. Supplement or health brands.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

The scripts and the system already exist. You are not inventing the strategy, you are executing it well and fast.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid trial first: one script, one finished VSL — generated B-roll, voiceover, captions, sound, Meta-ready. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.

title: SEO content and topical authority assistant
description:
We are looking for a reliable SEO content specialist to support a growing portfolio of UK businesses across several different industries.



This is not a role for someone who simply generates articles using ChatGPT and sends them over.



We already use AI extensively.



What we need is someone who can think.



You should understand why a page exists, what somebody is searching for, how that page fits into the wider website, what supporting content should surround it, and how to make the finished content sound like the actual business rather than generic AI-generated copy.



This will initially be a part-time position with the potential to grow significantly for the right person.



## What you will be doing



Your work will include:



* Researching topics and search intent before writing

* Reviewing Google search results and competitor content

* Creating SEO content briefs

* Identifying content clusters and supporting article opportunities

* Writing service pages, location pages, landing pages and articles

* Creating internal linking recommendations

* Identifying relevant entities, subtopics and FAQs

* Following an existing keyword strategy where provided

* Helping expand broad keywords into useful topical clusters

* Matching the tone of voice of completely different client brands

* Updating and improving existing content

* Structuring articles properly using headings and logical information hierarchy

* Using AI to accelerate your work without allowing AI to replace your judgement

* Fact checking anything generated with AI before submitting it



You will not initially be responsible for uploading content into WordPress.



Your responsibility is creating high-quality content and recommendations that are ready for our team to review and publish.



## What good work looks like



If we give you a plumbing company, SaaS company and professional services business, the content should not sound like it came from the same writer or prompt.



Before writing an article, you should naturally be asking questions such as:



What is the actual search intent?



What pages already exist on the website?



What should this page link to?



What pages should link back to this page?



Is this a standalone topic or part of a larger cluster?



What information is competitors consistently covering?



What are competitors missing?



Does this article genuinely deserve to rank?



Could somebody tell that AI helped produce this?



If your process is simply keyword + prompt + 1,500-word article, this role will not be a good fit.



## Skills we are looking for



You should have experience with several of the following:



* SEO content writing

* Search intent analysis

* Keyword research

* Topic clustering

* Topical authority

* Content briefs

* Content optimisation

* Internal linking

* Competitor research

* SERP analysis

* Google Search Console

* Ahrefs, Semrush or similar SEO tools

* WordPress

* ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools



You do not need to know everything.



Strong thinking, attention to detail and reliability matter more to us than having every SEO certification available.



## Using AI



We actively encourage the use of AI.



However, there is a major difference between using AI as a tool and submitting AI-generated content without thinking.



AI can help you research, organise, expand, draft and edit.



You are still responsible for:



* Accuracy

* Originality

* Search intent

* Structure

* Brand voice

* Relevance

* Quality



We will reject generic AI content.



## Working arrangement



This is initially a part-time remote position.



Starting budget:



$200 to $300 USD per month depending on experience, availability and output.



We care more about consistent high-quality output than tracking every minute you work.



If you become someone we can trust across client accounts, there is substantial scope for the role, responsibilities and compensation to increase.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming part of the way we operate rather than somebody looking to churn through another freelance writing gig.



## How to apply



Please do not send a generic application.



Start your application with the words:



**Purple Penguin**



Applications without those words will be ignored.



Then answer the following five questions.



### 1. Show us your work



Send links to two pieces of SEO content you personally created.



For each one, briefly explain:



* What keyword or topic you targeted

* What the search intent was

* What you personally did

* Why you structured the content the way you did



### 2. Show us how you think about clusters



Imagine you are working with a UK plumber who wants to rank for:



**boiler installation**



Give us:



* The primary page you would create

* Five supporting content ideas

* Two related commercial pages

* How you would internally link these pages together



Keep this concise.



### 3. Tell us how you use AI



Explain exactly how you currently use ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool when creating SEO content.



We are not looking for somebody who claims they never use AI.



We want to understand your process.



### 4. Spot the problem



Tell us why the following approach is weak:



"Find a keyword with good volume, ask ChatGPT to write a 2,000-word SEO article about it, add the keyword to the title and headings, then publish it."



Your answer should be no more than 150 words.



### 5. Tell us about you



Include:



* Your current availability

* Your expected monthly salary

* Your timezone

* How many clients or employers you currently work with

* The SEO tools you have previously used



Finally, at the bottom of your application, tell us your favourite food.



This is simply to confirm you have read the entire job description.



## Important



Please do not apply if:



* You submit completely AI-generated applications

* You cannot demonstrate previous writing

* You frequently miss deadlines

* You need detailed instructions for every small task

* You consider SEO writing to mean putting keywords into an article repeatedly

* You are applying for dozens of unrelated VA jobs at the same time



We are happy to teach our processes.



We cannot teach care, curiosity or reliability.



If you are someone who enjoys understanding why content performs rather than simply producing more words, we would like to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant / Generalist VA — Creative Studio (Admin, Social, Client Ops)
description:
**Role**



Own the operational engine of the studio. One person, four surfaces: the founder's inbox and calendar, our published content, live client projects, and the top of the new-business funnel. You are the reason nothing gets dropped, nobody has to chase, and the founder spends their day on work only they can do. Scope is deliberately broad now and narrows later — as volume grows, content and social splits off into its own hire and you choose which half you want to lead.



**What you'll do**



Inbox and calendar

- Triage the founder's inbox daily: d
 what needs them, draft the routine replies, clear the rest

- Own the calendar across GST, EST, and PST — schedule, reschedule, defend focus blocks, never double-book

- Issue invoices, chase overdue payments, keep the expense log current

- Run Drive like a filing system, not a dumping ground: naming conventions, versioning, nothing unfindable

- Handle travel, vendor accounts, and subscription admin



Content and social

- Schedule and publish across Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube on a calendar you maintain

- Write captions in studio voice, adapt copy per platform, size and format every asset correctly

- Light Canva work and basic video trims, cuts, and subtitles

- Monitor comments and DMs, answer the routine ones, escalate what matters

- Flag calendar gaps two weeks out, before they become a scramble

- Pull monthly performance into a report that says what changed and why, not just the numbers



Client and project operations

- Be the fast, reliable reply on client threads — acknowledge same day, chase answers, keep nothing waiting

- Keep every project current in the tracker: statuses, owners, dates, blockers surfaced early

- Prepare briefs, agendas, and call recaps with clear owners and deadlines attached

- Manage deliverable handoffs — correct files, working links, on time, first try

- Run the follow-up loop after every call so nothing dies in someone's inbox



Research and new business

- Build and clean prospect lists against our target profile

- Research brands, competitors, and category trends into short usable summaries, not link dumps

- Run first-touch outreach sequences and track what gets answered

- Keep the CRM accurate: no duplicates, no stale records, no guessing



Cross-functional

- Write the SOP for every recurring task you take over, so the role is transferable by design

- Give a short daily status and one weekly call — otherwise fully async



**You should have**

- 2 to 5 years as a VA, EA, or agency coordinator, ideally inside a creative, media, or marketing business

- Writing strong enough to go out under someone else's name, US English

- A system for tracking commitments that lives outside your head

- Fluency in Google Workspace, a project tool (Notion, ClickUp, or Asana), and Canva

- Consistent overlap with Dubai hours and the discretion to sit near contracts, budgets, and unreleased work

- Bonus: CapCut or Premiere, social scheduling tools, CRM or outreach platforms, invoicing software



**How we measure it**

- Response time on client and inbound threads

- Deadlines held per project, and how early slippage gets flagged

- How few things the founder has to ask about twice

- Content published on schedule, at platform standard

- Qualified prospects added and sequenced per month



**Not a fit if**

- You need every task specified before you'll start it

- You go quiet when you're stuck

- You're serving several other clients during our working hours

title: Marketing & Operations Assistant
description:
We're Hiring: Marketing & Operations Assistant

Location: 100% remote (based in Philippines)

_________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.

We’re looking for a Marketing & Operations Assistant to join our team. In this role, you will split your time between driving our Amazon channel expansion and keeping the supply chain humming through weekly inventory checks and fulfilment routines.

_________________________________________________

- Serve as the system keeper—ensuring team processes are actively used and marketing deliverables are followed through on time.



- Manage inbound collaboration inquiries, handle creator communications, and execute basic website updates.



Operations & Supply Chain Support

- Conduct weekly inventory health checks to proactively flag out-of-stock (OOS) and overstock risks.



- Conduct inventory planning and inventory fulfilment forecasting to keep stock aligned with demand.



- Support routine warehouse operations, including order splits, clearing warehouse stock, and routine fulfillment tasks.

_________________________________________________



You’re a Fit If You Have:



- Experience in building listings, uploading assets, setting up A+ Content, and managing FBA routines.



- Comfortable providing ad support by tracking keywords, impressions, and basic campaign performance metrics.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.



- Comfortable with spreadsheets, order splits, warehouse clearing, and tracking overstock or out-of-stock risks.



- Friendly and professional when managing incoming creator collaborations and basic website updates.



- Detail-oriented mindset that spots typos in listings or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between creative marketing tasks and practical operations support.

_________________________________________________



Why Join JazzUpCo?



- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



- Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants while sharpening your strategic project management skills and growing into a senior operations leader.



-Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________



Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:



1) Apply: Via the application form -
 (OJPH)

2) First Interview: Get to know each other

3) Trial Task: Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team: Onboarding + probation --> full-time hire



We can’t wait to meet you!

description:
This is a plumbing and fire-fighting design role, not a general MEP or HVAC position. You must have at least 4 years of experience designing plumbing and fire-fighting systems and be able to perform the engineering calculations yourself. This is not a CAD or Revit drafting role. You will be responsible for the design, calculations, coordination, and final deliverables.



About This Role

We are looking for an experienced MEP Design Engineer – Plumbing (PHE) to design plumbing and fire-fighting systems for residential and commercial projects.



You will work on systems including water supply, hot water, drainage, stormwater, rainwater harvesting, sewer and venting, sewage ejectors, sprinklers, hydrants, and fire pumps.



You will perform the required hydraulic and sizing calculations, create designs and 3D models, prepare BOQs and material take-offs, and participate in BIM coordination and clash resolution.



What You’ll Do

Design plumbing and fire-fighting systems from concept to detailed design

Design cold water, hot water, and hot water return systems

Design sewer, drainage, and venting systems

Design stormwater and rainwater harvesting systems

Design sewage ejector systems

Design sprinkler, hydrant, and fire pump systems

Perform hydraulic calculations for water supply, drainage, and sprinklers

Perform water demand and tank sizing calculations

Perform pipe sizing calculations

Prepare layouts, schematics, and 3D models

Use AutoCAD 2020, Revit MEP 2020, and BIM 360

Participate in BIM 360 coordination

Identify and resolve clashes with architectural, structural, and electrical teams

Prepare BOQs and material take-offs

Prepare project documentation

Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, specifications, and engineering standards



What We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in plumbing/PHE and fire-fighting design

Experience with residential and commercial projects

Strong plumbing/PHE design experience

Fire-fighting design experience

Experience with hydraulic calculations

Experience with water demand and tank sizing

Experience with pipe sizing

Experience with cold and hot water systems

Experience with sewer, drainage, and venting

Experience with stormwater and rainwater harvesting

Experience with sewage ejector systems

Proficiency in AutoCAD 2020

Proficiency in Revit MEP 2020

Experience with BIM 360

Experience with BOQs and material take-offs

Experience with MEP coordination and clash resolution

Strong problem-solving and attention to detail

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Important: This is a design engineering role, not a drafting position. You must be able to perform and understand the calculations behind your designs rather than simply create drawings based on another engineer's work.

SketchUp

STAAD.Pro

Experience with hotels, schools, restaurants, or fitness clubs

Communication is most of it. You'll be in our CRM, in Slack and on WhatsApp all day - talking to guests, cleaners, maintenance, contractors, suppliers and owners, and keeping our internal team informed. The rest is paperwork: passport and registration documents, DTCM, records, reports. Getting it right, and getting it finished.



Guest relations:



- Manage guest communication, inbound and outbound

- Coordinate check-in and check-out

- Handle issues during a stay and follow them through to a result, not just a reply

- Coordinate cleaners and suppliers via WhatsApp and Slack



Maintenance coordination:



- Log every reported issue and keep it visible until it's actually fixed

- Dispatch technicians, including after hours, and confirm the job was done

- Chase contractors and suppliers who go quiet

- Spot problems that keep coming back and say so



New unit launches:



- Coordinate a new apartment from handover to first booking - furniture delivery, installation, deep clean, photos, keys and access

- Handle the paperwork: DTCM registration, documents, listing setup across platforms

- Keep the owner and the internal team updated on where each unit stands



Operations and admin:



- Collect and process guest documents for registration - on time, every time

- Keep our CRM accurate: bookings, unit status, guest records

- Prepare and check reports and documents

- Escalate the right things to the senior team, and only the right things



Systems, as you grow into it:



- Write and maintain SOPs

- Improve how the team works, not just do the tasks

- Build simple automations between our tools



TWO THINGS MATTER MORE TO US THAN ANYTHING ELSE



You chase things until they're done.



Most of this job is waiting on other people - a guest who hasn't sent a document, a contractor who read your message and didn't answer, an owner sitting on an approval. Asking once is not doing the task. We need someone who tracks every open thread, notices who has gone quiet, and pushes again - politely, on a schedule, switching channel and escalating when it isn't working. Silence from the other side is not a finished task.



You check before you answer.



When a source contradicts what we've written, or something doesn't add up, stop and find out which is true rather than passing on the first answer you found. Being right matters more here than being fast, and one good question beats a confident wrong answer.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You follow up. You have a real system for tracking what you're waiting on

- You verify. You notice when two sources disagree and you resolve it

- Fluent English, written and spoken - natural and clear, not translated-sounding

- You own tasks. You d
 what you can d
 and escalate what you can't

- Structured. You follow SOPs, and you write them when they're missing

- Accurate with detail - numbers, dates, documents

- Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, WhatsApp



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- 6+ months in Airbnb operations or another short-term rental company

- 6+ months in a small team or startup

- Experience helping a company scale from 10 to 50+ units is a big plus

- Familiarity with guest communication, pricing tools, turnover coordination

- Experience writing SOPs or building team processes



WHAT WE OFFER



- $4-6/hour depending on experience

- Flexible workload, 40-60 hrs/week, 5-6 days - you tell us what suits you

- Direct work with the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Opportunity to grow into Team Lead as we scale



HOW TO APPLY



We don't accept direct messages. Applications without a completed form are ignored.



The application has two parts:



Part 1 - a short form about you and your experience (about 10 minutes)

Part 2 - five real situations from our operations. You'll get the link right after you submit Part 1. You have 60 minutes from that moment, and we record how long it takes.



Part 2 has no trick questions and no perfect answers. We want to see how you think and how fast you get to a result.



Form: 



Looking forward to hearing from you!



Nikita

title: Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions Tech VA
description:
Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions

Tech VA

Compensation: Starting at $15/hour, with an eventual target of $2,000–$3,000 USD/month, depending on

experience, availability, and proven client-facing deployment capabilities

Schedule: CST Time Zone

Employment Type: Contract

Seniority: Senior-Level



About the Role



We are looking for a Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions Tech VA who can bridge the gap

between client business needs and technical implementation.

This is not a purely execution-focused automation role. You will join discovery and sales calls, understand

the client's operational challenges, determine technical feasibility, recommend practical solutions, scope

implementations, and then take ownership of building, testing, deploying, and stabilizing those solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI automation specialist with strong client-facing and business

communication skills who can work independently with minimal supervision. You should be comfortable

turning ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions while maintaining realistic expectations

around scope, timelines, complexity, and fulfillment requirements.

Key Responsibilities



Client Discovery & Technical Consulting



Join prospect and client discovery calls as the company's technical solutions expert.

Lead the technical portion of discovery conversations and uncover:

Current workflows and processes

Operational bottlenecks

Existing systems and tools

Business requirements

Automation opportunities

Desired outcomes and success metrics

Ask strong technical and operational questions to fully understand the client's needs.

Identify the most practical initial solution based on business value, technical feasibility, complexity,

cost, and deployment risk.

Clearly communicate technical limitations and avoid overpromising.



Solution Design & Scoping



Translate discovery findings into clear technical scopes and implementation plans.

Develop workflow maps, technical requirements, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and

estimated fulfillment requirements.

Assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risks, integrations, and potential blockers

before proposals are finalized.

Support Client in developing accurate proposals and setting realistic client expectations.

Support solution demonstrations and technical presentations when required.



AI Automation & Implementation



Build, configure, test, and deploy approved AI automation solutions.

Develop CRM automations, AI agents, lead qualification systems, appointment-booking workflows,

follow-up sequences, and system integrations.

Integrate third-party platforms through APIs, webhooks, and automation tools.

Work with platforms such as GoHighLevel and leading no-code/low-code automation platforms.

Build and deploy solutions involving AI voice, SMS,
, lead reactivation, candidate engagement,

and appointment setting where applicable.

Ensure implementations are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the approved scope.



Testing, QA & Troubleshooting



Test every workflow end-to-end before client launch.

Validate integrations, triggers, actions, data flow, notifications, and edge cases.

Troubleshoot technical issues independently and resolve problems with minimal supervision.

Identify and address potential failure points before deployment.

Minimize technical errors, rework, and preventable scope changes.



Client Implementation & Post-Launch Support



Own client onboarding and implementation from approved scope through successful deployment.

Provide clear and proactive updates on progress, blockers, decisions, and next steps.

Create technical documentation and implementation records for every deployment.

Support post-launch stabilization and troubleshoot issues that arise after implementation.

Ensure reliable handoff and maintain stable, functioning automations after launch.

Identify potential expansion opportunities only after the initial implementation has produced a

measurable result.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Coordinate effectively with closers, account managers, developers, internal teams, and third-party

vendors.

Communicate technical requirements and implementation needs clearly to non-technical and

technical stakeholders.

Proactively manage dependencies and escalate critical blockers when necessary.

Manage multiple client opportunities and implementations while maintaining quality and

responsiveness.





Required Qualifications



Senior-level experience designing, building, testing, and deploying AI automation solutions for

external clients.

Proven experience participating in client discovery, technical consulting, or solution-selling

conversations.

Ability to ask strong technical and operational questions and independently identify appropriate

solutions.

Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into:

Technical requirements

Workflow designs

Implementation scopes

Timelines

Milestones

Deployment plans

Strong hands-on experience with:

CRM automation

APIs

Webhooks

AI agents

Lead qualification

Appointment booking

Follow-up automation

System integrations

Strong proficiency with GoHighLevel and leading no-code/low-code automation platforms.

Ability to assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risks, dependencies, and fulfillment

requirements before a proposal is finalized.

Excellent client-facing communication skills and strong business judgment.

Ability to avoid overpromising and set realistic expectations with clients.

Capable of working independently with minimal direction or hand-holding.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to document solutions and test workflows end-to-end.

Demonstrated ability to provide reliable post-launch support.

Must have verifiable examples of successful client deployments.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting staffing, recruiting, professional services, or agency clients.

Experience building:

AI voice systems

SMS automation

 automation

Lead-reactivation campaigns

Candidate-engagement systems

Appointment-setting workflows

Familiarity with white-label AI automation agency delivery.

Experience supporting proposal development, solution demonstrations, and sales calls.



Knowledge of data privacy, permission management, and secure credential handling.

Experience managing multiple client implementations simultaneously.

Experience coordinating with closers, account managers, developers, and third-party vendors.

Strong understanding of client delivery processes and post-launch support.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means being able to take ownership of an opportunity from discovery → solution

design → scoping → proposal support → implementation → testing → launch → stabilization without

requiring continuous oversight.

You should be able to confidently answer:

title: Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator (Amazon FBA)
description:
SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION HERE: 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Betashop GmbH is a Germany-based e-commerce company developing and selling physical consumer products across European Amazon marketplaces. Our portfolio spans home, lifestyle, hobby, and everyday consumer products.



The role of Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator combines supply chain coordination with sourcing and general Amazon FBA operations support. The role reports to the Senior Marketplace Manager.



As our Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator, you will gradually take ownership of the operational side of our purchase orders from start to finish. After onboarding and training, you will independently coordinate orders from placement through production, quality inspection, shipping, customs documentation, and final delivery.



Reorder quantities and purchasing decisions will be aligned with the Senior Marketplace Manager, while you are responsible for keeping the process moving, following up proactively, identifying issues early, and ensuring that all relevant information and documentation are accurate and up to date.



This is not a typical administrative or virtual assistant role. We are looking for someone who wants to build real ownership in supply chain and operations and take on increasing responsibility over time.



Supply chain coordination currently accounts for approximately 20–25 hours per week, although this can increase significantly during peak periods. The remaining time will be spent supporting broader Amazon FBA and business operations, such as sourcing, inventory coordination, listing optimisations, etc.



As our product portfolio and business continue to grow, we expect the scope of this role to grow with it. Our goal is to develop this position into a broad, long-term supply chain and operations role with increasing responsibility and independence.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

- Supply Chain & Logistics - 



- Manage purchase orders end-to-end after onboarding

- Coordinate reorder quantities and purchasing needs with the Senior Marketplace Manager

- Place orders and confirm prices, quantities, specifications, packaging, and payment terms

- Communicate directly with suppliers via
 and WeChat and proactively follow up on production progress

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date PO, production, and shipment trackers

- Coordinate quality inspections, review inspection reports, and follow up on corrective actions

- Coordinate freight forwarders, warehouses, and other logistics partners

- Review shipping and customs documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading

- Identify delays, discrepancies, missing information, or other risks early and escalate when necessary



- Amazon & General Operations -



- Maintain product and inventory-related information in Amazon Seller Central

- Open, manage, and follow up on cases with Amazon Seller Support

- Organize and maintain supplier, product, quality, and compliance documentation

- Research products, manufacturers, suppliers, and sourcing opportunities

- Help prepare and maintain product specifications, quality requirements, and packaging briefs

- Analyze customer reviews, returns, and feedback to identify recurring issues and opportunities for product improvement

- Support operational projects and process improvements across the business as needed 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Skills & Experience- 



- At least 1 year of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon FBA operations

- Experience communicating directly with suppliers or manufacturers, ideally in China

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

- Excellent attention to detail and proven ability to keep accurate records.

- Strong follow-up skills and the ability to work independently across multiple priorities

 

- Personality & Motivation - 



We are looking for someone who:

- Wants a long-term, full-time role

- Is reliable, honest, and transparent

- Takes ownership and follows up proactively

- Learns quickly and from mistakes

- Is motivated to take on increasing responsibility over time

 

CONTRACT AND WORK SET-UP

- Full-time (40 hours per week)

- Remote position, based in the Philippines

- Daily overlap with German business hours is required, with flexibility to structure the remaining working hours during regular business hours in Philippines

- Competitive salary based on experience and performance

- 13th month pay, pro-rated each December



After a successful probation period, support with work setup improvement is possible (e.g. computer, screen, desk, AC)



To succeed in this role you will need reliable electricity, a reliable computer, stable high-speed 50+ Mbps internet, a quiet workspace, video-call capability, and ability to work with WeChat, Slack and ClickUp. 



If this sounds like you, we can’t wait to meet you! Apply now and take the next step in your career with us!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

HOW TO APPLY



SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION HERE: 



Please include:



1. Your current CV



2. A short cover letter explaining how your experience and skills match this role. Please include in the cover letter



your current employment status

your earliest possible start date

that you are looking for long-term, full-time employment

Please state “BETASHOP” in the subject line of your Cover Letter



3. A 2-5 minute video introduction



We'd love to get a sense of who you are before we look at your experience on paper. Just talk to us naturally - there are no right or wrong answers: 



Some things you could cover:

Job Title: Account Executive (SEO & Client Services)



Job Overview

We are looking for an organized, communicative, and SEO-savvy Account Executive to join our agency. In this role, you will serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of client accounts and the project manager for their SEO campaigns.



You will be responsible for understanding our clients' organic growth goals, translating those goals into actionable project roadmaps for our technical and content teams, and ensuring all SEO deliverables are executed flawlessly and on time.

Client Relationship & Strategy Management

Primary Point of Contact: Lead regular client status meetings (weekly/monthly) to review SEO performance, present campaign reports, and align on next steps.

Jargon Translation: Translate complex SEO concepts, technical audits, and data metrics into clear, business-driven insights that clients can easily understand.

AI-Enhanced Reporting: Leverage AI tools and automated reporting dashboards to quickly synthesize raw data into actionable, high-level summaries for client review.

Retention & Organic Growth: Track client satisfaction and proactively identify opportunities to expand scopes of work (e.g., adding content creation, digital PR, or local SEO services).



SEO Project Management & AI Workflows

Campaign Roadmapping: Collaborate with SEO Strategists to turn technical audits and keyword research into structured monthly action plans.

AI Workflow Optimization: Utilize AI prompt engineering and automated workflows (e.g., using ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, or custom internal AI agents) to rapidly generate SEO content briefs, map keyword intent, and draft client communications.

Internal Resource Coordination: Delegate and track tasks across internal teams, including Content Writers (for blogs/on-page optimization), Developers (for technical fixes), and Link Builders.

AI-Assisted Quality Control: Fact-check, refine, and humanize AI-generated outlines or content drafts before they go to production, ensuring they align exactly with the client’s brand voice and E-E-A-T guidelines.

Quality Control: Review content and technical recommendations before they go to the client to ensure they meet agency standards and align with the client’s brand voice.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 1–3 years of experience in a digital marketing or SEO agency in an account management, project management, or client-facing role.

AI Fluency: Demonstrated experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) and prompt engineering to streamline day-to-day project management, copywriting, or data analysis tasks.

title: Mechanical / HVAC Analyst
description:
Real, hands-on HVAC and mechanical knowledge is the core requirement for this role. You will review equipment photos and specifications collected by field teams, assess existing and proposed boilers, heating, hot water, and cooling systems, perform BTU, kilowatt, and therm-based efficiency calculations, and determine whether projects qualify for utility rebates and the applicable rebate amount. You will also prepare reports, maintain project and permit trackers, and assist with permit documentation. You do not need prior experience with PSE&G or a specific utility rebate program — training and program guidance will be provided. What is essential is that you understand how HVAC and mechanical systems actually work and can independently perform the required calculations. If your experience is primarily administrative rebate processing without a strong technical HVAC foundation, this role is likely not a fit.



We are looking for a Mechanical / HVAC Analyst to support mechanical and HVAC projects by analyzing field data, evaluating equipment, performing energy and efficiency calculations, and determining utility rebate eligibility.



You will receive equipment information from field teams, including photographs, nameplates, specifications, and other project data. You will use this information to evaluate existing and proposed equipment and calculate potential efficiency improvements.



The role combines technical HVAC analysis, energy calculations, rebate research, reporting, and project administration. You will need to understand the technical characteristics of different heating, cooling, and hot water systems and be comfortable working with different fuel types, efficiency ratings, BTUs, kilowatts, and therms.



You will initially work with utility rebate requirements in New Jersey and will have the opportunity to learn additional programs and requirements as the scope of the role expands.



About This Role



You will work remotely with information gathered by field teams at customer properties. The field team will collect equipment photos, model and serial information, nameplate data, specifications, and other relevant details. Your responsibility is to analyze that information and determine what it means from an engineering and efficiency perspective.



You will assess existing equipment against proposed replacements and perform the calculations needed to determine efficiency improvements. This may involve working with boilers, heating equipment, hot water systems, cooling equipment, different fuel types, and varying efficiency ratings.



A significant part of the role involves utility rebate analysis. You will research program requirements, interpret eligibility criteria, review project information, and determine whether a project qualifies and what rebate amount may be applicable.



You will also prepare detailed reports and maintain accurate project and permit tracking information. As part of the process, you may assist with preparing documentation required for permits and rebate submissions.



This position requires someone who can work independently and take ownership of the analysis. You will receive the field information, but the responsibility for reviewing the data, performing the calculations, identifying missing information, and producing accurate results will be yours.



What You’ll Do

Review equipment photographs, nameplate information, specifications, and field data

Analyze existing and proposed boilers, heating, hot water, and cooling equipment

Evaluate equipment specifications and efficiency ratings

Compare existing equipment with proposed replacement equipment

Calculate potential efficiency improvements



Perform calculations involving:

BTUs

Kilowatts

Therms

Fuel consumption

Equipment efficiency ratings



Work with different fuel types and equipment configurations

Research utility rebate programs and their eligibility requirements

Interpret rebate program rules and project requirements

Determine whether projects qualify for available utility rebates

Calculate or estimate applicable rebate amounts based on project data

Prepare detailed project reports using Excel or Google Sheets

Maintain accurate project and permit tracking information

Update centralized project databases and trackers

Assist with permit paperwork and supporting documentation

Identify missing or inconsistent project information and follow up as needed

Maintain accurate documentation for rebate and project submissions

Work independently and manage assigned projects and deadlines



What We’re Looking For

Strong hands-on experience with HVAC and mechanical systems

Practical understanding of boilers, heating, hot water, and cooling systems

Ability to understand how mechanical and HVAC systems operate in real-world applications

Strong knowledge of equipment specifications and efficiency ratings

Understanding of BTUs, kilowatts, therms, fuel types, and energy efficiency

Ability to perform calculations involving different equipment types and fuel sources

Ability to compare existing and proposed equipment and determine efficiency improvements

Strong analytical and numerical skills

Ability to research and interpret technical or utility program requirements

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Experience preparing technical reports and documentation

Experience maintaining project trackers, databases, or permit tracking systems

Strong attention to detail

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Comfortable working U.S. business hours

Strong written and verbal English communication skills



Important: Prior experience with PSE&G or another specific U.S. utility rebate program is not required. Training and program guidance will be provided. The critical requirement is having a strong technical understanding of HVAC and mechanical systems and being able to perform the calculations independently.



Nice to Have

Previous experience with utility rebate programs

Experience with PSE&G or other U.S. utility programs

Experience working with energy-efficiency or HVAC incentive programs

Knowledge of rebate programs across multiple U.S. states
