title: CRM Data Migration & Automation Specialist
description:
???? Remote | Full Time



We are a UK hospitality business. Our customer data is scattered across four separate platforms and nobody can see the full picture of any single customer. We have bought GoHighLevel and we need one person, for four weeks, to consolidate everything into it properly and build the core automations on top.



This is a fixed 4-week contract, 40 hours per week, at $7 USD per hour. If the work is excellent there is a strong chance of extension into later phases.



This is a data job first and an automation job second. Roughly two of the four weeks are careful spreadsheet work. If deduplicating 29,000 messy rows into 21,000 clean ones sounds satisfying rather than tedious, you will enjoy this.



Background: what we are doing and why



We would rather you understood the point of the work than just followed instructions, so here is the honest picture.



The business. A long-established UK venue with several separately bookable spaces, plus a second smaller venue next door. It is busy at weekends and has a lot of unused capacity midweek. Around 21,000 customers have passed through it over more than a decade.



The problem we are solving. UK nightlife is shrinking. This business cannot grow by pulling in more walk-up customers on its busiest night, because that night is already close to full. Growth has to come from planned occasions instead — private room hire, group bookings, seasonal parties, corporate events. Those get booked weeks ahead, are paid for by organisers or company budgets, and happen on the nights the venue is half empty anyway.



To make that shift, the business needs to be able to reach the customers it already has. Right now it cannot. That is what you are fixing.



How the data got into this state. Nobody planned it. Platforms were adopted one at a time over a decade as they were needed — a booking system, then a ticketing platform, then a replacement ticketing platform, then an
 tool. None of them were ever connected to each other. Each holds a partial, overlapping view of the same people.



What is actually broken today:



The same customer exists three or four times over, so a loyal regular looks like several strangers

Booking counts are calculated per platform, so the loyalty tiers are wrong and the genuine best customers are invisible

Enquiries arrive in six different places, get replied to once, then are never chased. Nobody knows how many are lost, because nothing counts them.

Opt-out records exist in only one system — which is a legal risk, and the reason the suppression work matters so much



The four things this programme is meant to achieve:



Re-engage people who enquired but never booked

Re-engage customers who came once and never returned

Get the customer base signed up to a free loyalty scheme (whose real purpose is collecting proper marketing consent)

Make sure no booking enquiry is ever missed again



Where your four weeks fit. The full programme is about 18 stages and 165–225 hours. Your contract is the first and most important slice: the foundation and the data migration. Later stages are blocked by things nobody can speed up — API credentials from a supplier, business verification with Meta, and a mandatory 3–4 week
 domain warm-up. So you are not expected to finish the whole programme. You are expected to complete your part to a standard that lets the next stage start cleanly.



Who you will work with. A UK project owner (your daily contact), the venue's general manager and assistant manager (who you will train at handover), an external developer handling the API work, and a UK marketing agency who own the CRM account at the top level.



What you will actually be doing



The work falls into four areas. We will agree the running order at kickoff, once we have looked at the data exports together and seen what condition they are in.



Setting up the foundation



Set up and configure a GoHighLevel sub-account from scratch

Build 13 custom fields, around 40 tags and a 9-stage pipeline, exactly to a written specification

Audit an
 marketing platform we are retiring: its lists, automations, forms and API keys

Export data from four platforms and log everything



The data migration — this is the main event



Build a master suppression list of everyone who has opted out, and load it into the CRM before anything else

Normalise four very different exports into one consistent 14-column format

Deduplicate on
 and phone, applying precise merge rules supplied to you

Score and tag every record by frequency, recency, value and product using formulas

Import in tranches, reconciling the numbers after each one

Produce a one-page reconciliation report



Building the core automations



An enquiry acknowledgement that fires within 60 seconds

A follow-up chase sequence that stops the instant a customer replies on any channel

An automated review request flow

A signup form that captures marketing consent correctly

A webhook feed from a ticketing platform



Testing and handover



Work through a supplied test checklist, evidencing every item

Write a runbook someone non-technical can follow

Record a walkthrough and hand over cleanly



You will be given a detailed written build manual covering every step. You are not being asked to design the approach. You are being asked to execute it accurately and to tell us immediately when something does not add up.



What we need from you



Essential



Advanced spreadsheet skills. This is the single most important requirement. You must be genuinely comfortable deduplicating tens of thousands of rows, writing lookup and conditional formulas, cleaning inconsistent data, and reconciling totals back to a source.

Hands-on CRM administration. You have personally configured a CRM — custom fields, tags, pipelines, imports, automations. GoHighLevel is ideal. HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Zoho or Keap experience is acceptable if you are a fast learner.

Automation building. Multi-step workflows with conditions, waits and branching. Zapier or Make experience.

Strong written English. You will write audit notes, a reconciliation report and a runbook a non-technical person must be able to follow.

Precision over initiative. On this project, following the specification exactly matters more than clever improvisation.

Reliability. 40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours daily overlapping UK business hours (roughly 4pm to 8pm Philippine time).



Nice to have, not required



Familiarity with UK GDPR or PECR marketing consent rules

 deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)

Experience migrating between
 marketing platforms

Light scripting for data cleaning (Python or Google Apps Script)

Hospitality, events or booking system experience



The terms

   

Rate    $7.00 USD per hour

Hours    40 per week, Monday to Friday

Term    4 weeks, fixed

Payment    TBD

Equipment    Your own computer and reliable internet



How to apply



Please do not send a generic application. We read the ones that follow these instructions and skip the rest. It takes about 15 minutes and we promise to reply either way.

title: Analytical Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
Remote · Full-Time · U.S. Business Hours



This role goes well beyond data entry. You must be able to notice when numbers do not make sense, investigate the cause yourself, and resolve issues without waiting for step-by-step guidance. You will be responsible for reconciling vendor statements, identifying missing or duplicate bills, investigating discrepancies, and following issues through to their root cause. Hands-on QuickBooks Online experience is required, along with inventory bookkeeping experience, including unit conversions such as pounds to kilograms. Clear spoken and written English is essential because you will communicate directly with U.S.-based stakeholders. If your bookkeeping experience is primarily entering transactions that someone else has already reviewed, this role is likely not a fit.



We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Bookkeeping Specialist to support the financial operations of a fast-growing U.S. food manufacturing business. You will handle accounts payable, vendor statement reconciliation, account reconciliations, and inventory bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online.



This is a role for someone who thinks beyond the numbers. When something does not add up, you are expected to notice it, investigate what happened, determine the root cause, and resolve it independently. The business is growing quickly, so you should be comfortable working with evolving processes, minimal supervision, and taking ownership of bookkeeping issues from start to finish.



About This Role

You will take ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping activities, including managing accounts payable, entering and reconciling bills from multiple sources, scheduling vendor payments, performing account reconciliations, and maintaining accurate inventory records.



Because this is a food manufacturing business, inventory bookkeeping is an important part of the role. You should be comfortable working with physical inventory and performing unit conversions, such as converting pounds to kilograms, when recording or reconciling inventory-related information.



The most important part of this position is your ability to identify and solve problems. If a vendor statement does not match the books, a bill appears to have been entered twice, a bill is missing, or an inventory balance does not make sense, you should be able to investigate the issue and determine what needs to be corrected.



You will also be expected to communicate your findings clearly, explain discrepancies and their causes, and document or communicate the actions taken to resolve them.



What You’ll Do

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping activities and maintain accurate financial records

Manage accounts payable, including entering bills from multiple sources

Schedule and track vendor payments

Reconcile vendor statements against internal accounting records

Investigate and resolve vendor statement discrepancies

Perform account reconciliations in QuickBooks Online

Record inventory-related bookkeeping entries and calculations

Perform inventory unit conversions, such as pounds to kilograms

Identify missing, duplicate, or incorrect bills

Investigate discrepancies and determine their root causes

Resolve bookkeeping issues independently and follow them through to completion

Apply 3-way matching and other accounts payable controls

Maintain accurate and reliable financial records

Help maintain organized bookkeeping processes as the business continues to grow

Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping accuracy and efficiency

Communicate findings, discrepancies, and resolutions clearly with U.S.-based stakeholders

Work independently while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy



What We’re Looking For

Hands-on bookkeeping experience

Strong experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO)

Experience managing accounts payable

Experience with bill entry and payment scheduling

Experience reconciling vendor statements

Experience performing account reconciliations

Strong discrepancy investigation and root-cause analysis skills

Experience with inventory-related bookkeeping and calculations

Comfortable performing inventory unit conversions, such as pounds to kilograms

Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Ability to explain financial discrepancies clearly and professionally

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Strong ownership and follow-through

Comfortable working in a growing business where processes may continue to evolve

Able to work U.S. business hours



Important: This is not a data-entry-only position. We need someone who can review the numbers, recognize when something is wrong, investigate why it happened, and take the appropriate action to resolve it.



Nice to Have

Inventory accounting or inventory-related bookkeeping experience

Experience with 3-way matching or similar accounts payable controls

Experience with NetSuite or another ERP/accounting system

Experience supporting manufacturing or food-related businesses

Experience working with U.S.-based businesses

Experience with vendor reconciliation and discrepancy resolution

Experience improving or establishing bookkeeping processes



About Us

We are a growing company focused on building a reliable, high-performing remote team. We value ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and people who can solve problems independently.



You will have the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of your work, contribute to improving our financial processes, and work closely with a U.S.-based team in a long-term remote position.

title: Long-Term Video Editor — Documentary-Style YouTube Channel (Retention-Focused)
description:
Long-Term Video Editor — Documentary-Style YouTube Channel (Retention-Focused)



Rate: $30 AUD per finished 12-minute video Volume: 4 videos per week Type: Ongoing, long-term. Not a one-off project.



About the channel



Forgotten Beasts is a faceless documentary channel about extinct animals, lost species, and creatures people believe might still be out there. Audience is mostly US, UK and Australia, ages 34–55. Think mystery-thriller documentary, not listicle.



I write every script myself. You handle the edit: footage sourcing, cutting, sound design, text, pacing.



What I actually need from you



Views are not the problem. Retention is. I need an editor who understands that the edit is what keeps someone watching past minute three.



Here is the standard:



First 30 seconds. Target is 90% of viewers still watching at the 30-second mark. No logo, no channel intro, no slow build. Frame one must match the thumbnail exactly — if the thumbnail shows a thylacine, the first frame is a thylacine. Cuts every 2–3 seconds through the opening.



Change something on screen every 10–15 seconds. A digital zoom, a pan, a text pop, a hard cut, a music shift. If a clip has to sit longer than 3 seconds, add movement to it. Static frames kill retention.



Tension, then release. Never show the payoff shot while the voiceover is still explaining it. Build it, hold a beat, then drop the visual. If everything on screen is loud the whole time, nothing lands.



Sound leads picture. Place your SFX a few frames before the visual appears. Low rumbles for size, whooshes on transitions, paper crinkle for old documents and maps. Cut the music completely right before a big reveal.



Tease what's coming. When the script mentions an animal appearing later, flash a blurred or silhouetted frame of it for about 10 frames. Blink-and-you-miss-it. It makes people stay for the clear version.



Be ruthless with dead air. Remove breathing gaps, micro-pauses, and any second where nothing is happening. Use J-cuts so audio from the next section starts before the visual changes. Retention dies from a hundred small leaks, not one big one.



Archival treatment. When the script says an animal was last seen in 1936, the footage should look like 1936. Grain, black and white, film scratches, slight instability.



Fancy motion graphics do not matter here. Clean pacing does.



What I provide

Full script with timestamps, emotion notes and edit cues already marked

Voiceover audio

Thumbnail and title before you start, so you know what promise the edit has to deliver on

Stock accounts if needed

Pay, bonuses and revenue share

$30 per 12-minute video, paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

Retention bonus: +$[10] per video that holds above [50]% average view duration

Breakout bonus: +$[50] for any video that passes [50,000] views in its first 30 days

Revenue share: once you have delivered consistently for [3] months, you move onto [5]% of the channel's monthly ad revenue on top of your per-video rate



The rate goes up as the channel grows. I would rather train one editor properly and keep them for years than cycle through cheap freelancers. If this channel scales, you scale with it.

Do not send a generic portfolio link. Applications without the following get ignored.

title: Reddit Community & Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Reddit-savvy person to help us build an authentic presence across relevant Reddit communities.



We are a SaaS company in the online forms space, and we want to introduce our tool to people who are already discussing topics related to forms, surveys, quizzes, polls, data collection, and similar tools.



This is *not a mass-posting or spam job*. We already have a curated list of relevant Reddit posts and discussions, so you will not be expected to spend your time researching subreddits or finding posting opportunities from scratch.



Instead, we will provide you with relevant opportunities, and your job will be to participate in these conversations naturally and appropriately.



What you'll do:



- Review the Reddit posts and discussions provided by our team

- Check the rules and guidelines of each subreddit before commenting

- Write short, clear, and natural comments that fit the conversation

- Recommend or mention our tool when it is relevant and appropriate

- Follow each community's rules, tone, and guidelines

- Avoid repetitive, overly promotional, or spammy comments

- Share the direct link to each published comment with our team for tracking

- Keep track of your published comments in a shared spreadsheet



You do not need to write long or highly detailed comments. We value clear, useful, and natural responses over lengthy answers. The goal is to recommend our tool in the right place and at the right time, while respecting each community's rules.



What we're looking for:



- Previous experience actively using Reddit

- A good understanding of Reddit communities, rules, and etiquette

- Strong written English

- The ability to write short, clear, and natural comments

- Good judgment when d
 how and when to mention a product

- The ability to follow subreddit-specific rules carefully

- Experience with SaaS, software, digital tools, or online communities is a plus



When applying, please share:



- Your Reddit profile(s)

- Examples of Reddit comments or posts you have written

- A short description of your Reddit experience

- Payment & Work Structure

- Type of Work: Part-time

- Hours: 10–15 hours per week

- Schedule: Flexible (there are no fixed working hours)

- Payment: $1 per approved comment

- Payment Schedule: Monthly



This is a flexible, part-time role. You can work according to your own schedule as long as you consistently publish relevant and high-quality comments.



We pay $1 for each approved comment that is relevant, original, clear, and compliant with the subreddit's rules.



Comments that are repetitive, irrelevant, overly promotional, removed by moderators, or posted solely to increase volume will not be counted.



After publishing a comment, you will share the direct link with our team. Approved comments will be tracked throughout the month, and the total payment will be calculated and sent at the end of each month.



Quality matters more than quantity. We are looking for someone who can promote our tool naturally, at the right place and the right time, without violating community rules or making the conversation feel like an advertisement

title: Finance & Operations Coordinator — Remote (Day Shift)
description:
Finance & Operations Coordinator — Remote (Day Shift)



TYPE OF WORK: Bookkeeping, Finance, Operations

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

JOB CATEGORY: Finance & Accounting

EMPLOYMENT TYPE: Full-Time

SALARY: $1,200–$1,400/month



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are a leading U.S.-based communications firm serving mission-driven organizations — schools, healthcare organizations, nonprofits, advocacy groups, campaigns, and civic institutions. We help our clients build visibility, public trust, and real momentum through strategy, creative, advertising, and outreach. We also manage our own portfolio of properties that generate recurring revenue and fund our operations.



We run a lean, AI-enabled operation and are growing fast. We need a sharp Finance & Operations Coordinator to own the money side end to end — someone who manages client invoicing, subcontractor payments, vendor costs, and keeps the books current. You'll work directly with the founder on cash management and directly with vendors and customers. This is the financial operations backbone of a growing firm and multi-property real estate business with recurring client contracts and active freelance talent. One big project: in December, you'll catch up eight months of backlogged bookkeeping during the quieter month.



Schedule: Three daytime Philippine options: 4AM–1PM PHT, 6AM–3PM PHT, or 7AM–4PM PHT. You'll have a twice-weekly check-in with the founder in PT (typically brief, structured, 15–20 minutes).



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Client Invoicing & Receivables

- Implement contract-to-cash: watch for fully executed contracts, draft the first invoice, and send it immediately

- Create and send recurring monthly invoices to clients

- Track what's paid, what's outstanding, and when to follow up

- Enforce payment terms (typically: invoice on delivery, payment due in 30 days)

- Keep AR aging clean and flag slow payers



Subcontractor Payments & Communication

- Review freelancer and vendor invoices for accuracy and rate verification

- Compile invoices into payment batches

- Log payment history and match to contracts

- Communicate with subcontractors about invoice status and timing

- Flag rate anomalies or scope creep

- Confirm a completed W-9 is on file before approving any first-time contractor invoice

- Track which vendors/subcontractors are approaching the $600 1099 reporting threshold and flag for year-end 1099 prep



Vendor Cost Management

- Build and maintain a directory of vendors (contractors, service providers, tool subscriptions)

- Document cost per item or rate per hour

- Run a quarterly rate audit: confirm we're getting competitive pricing

- Flag subscriptions that should be cancelled or renegotiated

- Present vendor cost trends in weekly and monthly reporting



Bookkeeping & Monthly Close

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payments (AP/AR)

- Categorize transactions into the chart of accounts

- Handle month-end reconciliation and close

- Use QuickBooks Online as your system of record

- December project: catch up eight months of backlogged entries and reconciliation



Cash Flow & Reporting

- Analyze cash flow weekly: money in, money out, runway, timing mismatches

- Prepare a weekly cash flow summary for the founder

- Monthly: produce a financial package (cash position, receivables aging, vendor summary, budget variance)

- Track and forecast based on contract pipeline and known expenses



Compliance Calendar

- Maintain a calendar of key annual deadlines (business registration renewals, 1099 filings, insurance renewals, and other regulatory dates)

- Set reminders at 60, 30, 14, and 7 days out from each deadline

- Alert the founder as deadlines approach so decisions can be made on time



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Experience:

- Accounting degree or equivalent background in accounting/bookkeeping

- 3+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience

- Comfortable owning reconciliation and month-end close

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting software



Core Skills:

- Exceptional written English (client-facing invoices and correspondence)

- Proficiency in Google Sheets, Notion, Slack, and Gmail

- Ability to organize and track dozens of small transactions and vendor relationships

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers



Mindset:

- Self-directed: you manage your own calendar, priorities, and handoff

- Proactive problem-finder: you flag issues before they become problems

- High integrity: you handle financial data and payments with absolute confidentiality and precision

- Collaborative: you're comfortable working with the founder and occasional freelancers



Nice-to-haves:

title: Amazon Handmade VA — T-Shirts & Custom Orders (Listings, Variations, PPC)
description:
Rate: Starting at $3.50/hour — approx. $720 - $800 /month



Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Manila time, Monday to Saturday, paid 30-minute break. Time-tracked.



READ AND FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.

Do not use AI to write your application. All answers are run through an AI detection tool (GPTZero / Originality.ai). I want your own words and your own experience — a short, plain answer from you is worth more to me than a polished one from ChatGPT. Applications that ignore the instructions below are rejected without reply.





ABOUT US

We are a small t-shirt shop. We print our own shirts in-house — every order is made by our own team, not outsourced. We sell on Etsy and are now opening an Amazon Handmade store for our t-shirts and custom personalized orders. This is a brand-new store and you will help build it from the ground up.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING

This role is Amazon Handmade specifically, not regular Seller Central and not Merch on Demand. If your experience is standard FBA or Merch, this is not the right fit. Handmade has its own artisan application, its own listing flow, its own fee structure, and its own rules. Do not apply if you have only worked the regular marketplace.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Build and manage Handmade listings, including applying the Handmade Classification attribute correctly

2. Set up and configure Amazon Custom for personalized orders — text fields, dropdowns, image uploads, and customization templates.

3. Build clean variation families for apparel (size × color) and keep them from breaking

4. Build out and optimize our Artisan Profile and storefront

5. Keyword research and listing SEO: titles, bullets, backend search terms

6. Run Sponsored Products campaigns — auto for discovery, manual for harvested keywords, negative keyword management

7. Scale the store: plan and execute SKU expansion, not just maintain what exists

8. Weekly report: sessions, conversion rate, ad spend, ACOS, units sold, and what you changed



REQUIREMENTS

1. Proven Amazon Handmade experience — you have personally worked inside a HANDMADE account

2. Experience with Amazon Custom and personalized/made-to-order products

3. Expert with variations — you can build a full size × color family and fix one when it breaks

4. Have personally run Sponsored Products campaigns and can defend your bid decisions

5. Understand that Custom products are seller-fulfilled and cannot go through FBA

6. Apparel category knowledge: size map, color map, fit type, department, material composition

7. Strong written English — you will be writing customer-facing copy

8. Reliable internet and a working backup connection



NICE TO HAVE

1. Experience taking a shop through the Handmade artisan application

2. Basic Photoshop or Canva for mockups, size charts, and customization previews



PROOF OF WORK — REQUIRED

Applications without proof will not be read. Send AT LEAST two:



1. 3 or more live Handmade ASINs you personally built — I will open them and check the variation setup and whether the Handmade badge is applied correctly

2. A link to an Artisan Profile you built or managed

3. Screenshot of Campaign Manager showing a campaign you ran — must show date range, spend, ACOS, and orders



Blur the account name if you are under NDA, but ASINs and metrics must be visible. Do not send course screenshots or someone else's results. I verify everything.



HOW TO APPLY

Put ARTISAN in your subject line or your application will not be read.



Answer briefly, in your own words (Not AI GENERATED):

1. Which Handmade account did you work on, and what products did it sell?

2. Walk me through setting up a customizable t-shirt listing with Amazon Custom. What customization options did you configure?

3. What is different about building a listing in Handmade versus regular Seller Central?

4. How would you scale a Handmade store from 20 SKUs to 200 without breaking the variation families?

5. How many SKUs did you manage, and how many variation children per parent? Then: name three things that break a variation family, and how you fix each one.

6. What t-shirt niches have you worked in? Give me the specific niches and tell me which ones actually sold.



Generic resumes with no answers are auto-rejected.

description:
One seat. Technical judgment. Full accountability.



This is not a “hold the calendar and smile” support role.



We’re looking for a Technical Engineering Coordinator who can move comfortably between engineering calculations, technical correspondence, project coordination, and executive-level administrative support.



You should be able to look at a structural or mechanical calculation sheet, understand what you’re looking at, identify potential discrepancies, communicate clearly with a client, and keep the project moving — without everything being divided across three different people.



If you’re an engineer who is organized, commercially minded, technically sharp, and comfortable owning a moving workload, this could be a very strong fit.



What You’ll Do



* Own the inbox, don’t babysit it. Monitor and triage incoming
s based on urgency and complexity. Handle routine matters independently, route appropriately when needed, and respond directly to technical inquiries when you have the knowledge and judgment to do so.

* Review and validate engineering calculations. Check calculations for accuracy, consistency, and potential discrepancies before they become project or client issues.

* Keep engineering projects moving. Track timelines, deliverables, dependencies, follow-ups, and outstanding items across multiple active projects.

* Review and mark up technical documents. Use Bluebeam or equivalent redlining/markup software to review plan sets, submittals, drawings, and technical documentation.

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support. Handle scheduling, correspondence, coordination, documentation, follow-ups, and the many operational details that keep an engineering practice running smoothly.

* Communicate with clients professionally. Draft clear, concise, technically appropriate responses where required and ensure communication does not get lost in translation.

* Use technology intelligently. Leverage Microsoft Office and AI tools to improve drafting, research, documentation, organization, and workflow efficiency.

* Take ownership. Identify what needs to happen next and make it happen rather than waiting for someone to assign every step.



Non-Negotiable Requirements



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering**

* 5+ years of executive assistant, administrative, coordination, or comparable professional experience**, ideally supporting engineering or technical leadership

* Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, priorities, and follow-ups

* Strong Microsoft Office proficiency, particularly Excel

* Familiarity with Bluebeam or comparable document markup/redlining software

* Strong spoken and written English

* Ability to understand and communicate technical information clearly

* Comfortable using AI tools for drafting, research, organization, and document-related tasks

* Strong technology skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Excellent judgment, organization, attention to detail, and follow-through



We’ll Evaluate You On



Relevant Work Experience



Your previous roles, scope of responsibilities, engineering/technical exposure, project coordination experience, and ability to operate at a high level.



Software & Technical Proficiency



Your working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, Bluebeam or equivalent markup tools, project management platforms, communication tools, and AI-enabled productivity tools.



Remote Work Experience & Adaptability



Your ability to stay productive, organized, responsive, and accountable without someone physically supervising your work.



English Proficiency — Spoken & Written



You must be able to communicate confidently and professionally with US-based clients and engineering professionals.



Professionalism & Attitude



We value ownership, maturity, good judgment, respect, and a solution-oriented mindset. We’re looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems.



Response Time & Clarity



In engineering, delays and vague communication can become expensive very quickly. You should be responsive, concise, and clear — especially when something requires immediate attention.



Internet & Work Setup



You must have a reliable internet connection, dependable computer/workstation, and professional remote-work environment suitable for full-time client-facing work.



Commitment to Role & Availability



This is a role that requires consistent attention and accountability. We’re looking for someone who can commit to the position and maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours.



Time Management & Dependability



You should be capable of managing competing priorities, meeting deadlines, following through on commitments, and keeping stakeholders informed without constant reminders.



Problem-Solving Skills



We want someone who can assess a situation, investigate, make reasonable decisions, and move things forward — not someone who stops at “there’s a problem.”



Willingness to Learn & Adapt



Engineering workflows, software, and client requirements evolve. You should be comfortable learning new tools and processes quickly and applying what you learn.



Hubstaff & Remote Accountability



This is a remote position, and Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work accountability.



You should be comfortable using Hubstaff appropriately and maintaining accurate work activity during scheduled hours. Remote work requires trust — and trust works both ways when expectations and accountability are clear.



Nice to Have



* Previous experience in an engineering firm, consultancy, construction company, or other technical environment

* Formal project management certification

Why This Role Matters

title: Technical Support Specialist – Security Systems
description:
Customer Support

Remote · Full-Time · U.S. Business Hours



This is remote diagnosis, not hands-on repair. You will not be physically touching the equipment. Instead, you will diagnose problems based on information provided by customers or field technicians and guide them through the appropriate troubleshooting steps. You need to know how to ask the right questions, interpret the answers, identify the likely cause, and explain the solution clearly enough for a non-technical person to follow. Experience with a specific manufacturer is not required — Honeywell, Bosch, Hikvision, Dahua, and similar platforms are helpful but can be learned. What is required is real hands-on troubleshooting experience with security, alarm, or low-voltage systems. If your background is primarily installation or bench repair without remote technical support, this role is likely not a fit.



We are looking for a Technical Support Specialist – Security Systems to provide remote technical support for alarm systems, security cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and access control equipment.



You will troubleshoot issues remotely through phone,
, and remote access. Customers may have little or no technical knowledge, so you must be able to translate technical problems into simple, clear instructions. You will also work with field technicians when an issue requires an on-site visit.



The role requires someone who can think through a problem independently rather than simply follow a troubleshooting script. You will need to determine whether an issue is related to configuration, connectivity, programming, equipment, or another underlying cause and determine the appropriate next step.



About This Role



You will be the first point of technical support when customers experience problems with their security systems.



Because you will be working remotely, you will often need to diagnose an issue without physically seeing or touching the equipment. You may be speaking with a customer who is unfamiliar with technical terminology or with a field technician who is currently working at the site.



You will ask targeted questions, gather information about the symptoms, analyze what is being reported, and guide the person through the appropriate troubleshooting process.



Issues may include network or connectivity problems affecting IP cameras, alarm panel configuration or programming issues, DVR/NVR problems, camera connectivity, access control issues, or equipment that may require replacement or an on-site technician.



You will document troubleshooting steps and resolutions in the ticketing system, assist with system configuration and programming, and coordinate with field technicians when an issue cannot be resolved remotely.



Clear communication is critical. You must be able to explain technical concepts in plain, easy-to-understand English and remain patient when assisting customers who are not technically experienced.



What You’ll Do

Provide remote technical support for security and low-voltage systems

Troubleshoot alarm panels, security cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and access control equipment

Diagnose system problems through phone,
, and remote access

Ask targeted questions to identify the cause of technical issues

Guide customers through troubleshooting and resolution steps remotely

Troubleshoot network and connectivity issues affecting IP cameras and other devices

Assist with system configuration and programming

Determine whether an issue can be resolved remotely or requires an on-site technician

Escalate complex or hardware-related issues appropriately

Coordinate with field technicians when an on-site visit is required

Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the ticketing system

Follow up with customers to confirm that issues have been resolved

Maintain accurate records of technical support activities

Provide clear and professional communication throughout the troubleshooting process



What We’re Looking For

Hands-on technical support or troubleshooting experience with security systems, alarm systems, or low-voltage systems

Knowledge of alarm panels and security camera systems

Experience with DVR and/or NVR systems

Understanding of IP cameras and basic network connectivity

Experience diagnosing technical problems remotely

Ability to troubleshoot systematically rather than simply follow a script

Ability to guide non-technical customers through technical procedures

Strong verbal and written English communication skills

Ability to explain technical concepts in simple, easy-to-understand language

Strong problem-solving and diagnostic skills

Strong patience and customer service skills

Experience using ticketing or technical support systems

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Comfortable coordinating with field technicians

Able to work U.S. business hours



Important: You do not need to have experience with a specific security system manufacturer. What matters is that you understand security and low-voltage systems and have genuine troubleshooting experience.



Nice to Have

Experience with Honeywell security systems

Experience with Bosch security systems

Experience with Hikvision cameras and systems

Experience with Dahua cameras and systems

Access control system experience

Experience with alarm monitoring platforms

Familiarity with security system mobile applications

Experience supporting U.S.-based customers

Experience working with field service or installation teams

Experience with remote access and diagnostic tools



PLEASE ATTACH YOUR CV WHEN APPLYING

title: Sales & Marketing Virtual Assistant – Long-Term, Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
Sales & Marketing Virtual Assistant – Long-Term, Part-Time to Full-Time



We are a growing, family-owned branded merchandise company in the United States looking for a dependable, organized Virtual Assistant to join our team long-term.



We provide branded apparel, promotional products, drinkware, print materials, signs, gifts, awards, and other custom products for businesses and organizations.



We are looking for someone who can help take administrative, sales-support, and marketing tasks off the owners' plates so we can spend more time working with customers and growing the business.



This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, but we anticipate it could grow into a full-time position within the next 6 months.



We are specifically looking for someone who is interested in growing with our company and who would have the availability to transition to full-time if the position expands.



WHAT YOU WILL HELP WITH



Sales & Customer Support



* Build customer quotes and orders using DecoNetwork

* Create customer product presentations and proposals using SAGE

* Research promotional products based on customer needs, quantities, budgets, and deadlines

* Compare products, supplier costs, setup charges, production times, imprint areas, available colors, and other specifications

* Keep track of open quotes, presentations, and sales opportunities

* Follow up with customers who have received quotes or presentations but have not responded

* Help identify reorder opportunities from existing customers

* Make updates and revisions to quotes and presentations as customer needs change

* Maintain organized customer, project, and order information

* Assist with other routine sales and administrative tasks as needed



Marketing



* Help maintain our social media posting schedule

* Use ChatGPT to help create social media captions and marketing content using our established brand voice

* Prepare social media posts using photos, product information, and completed-project information we provide

* Create
 marketing campaigns using SAGE

* Research products and themes for regular customer marketing
s

* Use ChatGPT to help develop subject lines,
 content, calls-to-action, and other marketing copy

* Repurpose completed customer projects and product research into additional social and
 marketing content

* Help us maintain a consistent marketing schedule even during busy production periods



Artwork & Product Mockups



Advanced graphic design is not required.



Basic Adobe Illustrator experience is preferred, but we are also open to someone who is comfortable learning the specific Illustrator tasks required for our workflow.



This role will include basic artwork handling. You will need to be able to:



* Open customer artwork in Adobe Illustrator

* Determine whether supplied artwork is vector or raster

* Recognize when artwork needs to be sent out for vectorization

* Place existing vector artwork onto our artboards or product templates

* Scale artwork proportionally to the correct imprint or decoration size

* Center and position artwork appropriately

* Make simple color changes when needed

* Create basic product mockups using supplied artwork

* Save and export files correctly for our workflow



You do not need to already know how to identify vector versus raster artwork. We can teach you this as part of our training. However, once trained, you will be expected to confidently recognize the difference and know when artwork needs to be sent out for vectorization.



You will not be expected to recreate complex logos, perform advanced graphic design, or manually vectorize difficult artwork.



SOFTWARE



You may work regularly with:



* SAGE

* DecoNetwork

* Adobe Illustrator

* ChatGPT

* Google Drive

*
 marketing tools

* Other common business software



Previous SAGE and/or DecoNetwork experience is strongly preferred, but NOT required.



If you have experience with either SAGE or DecoNetwork, please describe specifically what you have done within those programs.



Basic Adobe Illustrator experience is also preferred, particularly experience working with vector artwork, artboards, sizing, and simple product mockups.



We are willing to train an organized, capable person who is comfortable learning our specific systems and processes.



WHAT MATTERS MOST TO US



We are looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English

* Pays very close attention to details

* Is highly organized and dependable

* Communicates clearly when they have questions

* Is comfortable learning new software and processes

* Can follow written procedures and training videos

* Is comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT

* Can research information and use good judgment rather than simply copying and pasting

* Double-checks quantities, spelling, customer information, product specifications, artwork sizing, and deadlines

* Can manage recurring tasks without needing to be reminded every time

* Is comfortable communicating professionally with customers

* Takes initiative and looks for ways to make processes more efficient

* Wants a stable, long-term position with room to grow

* Would be interested and available to transition from part-time to full-time as the position grows



Experience in promotional products, printing, branded merchandise, apparel, customer service, sales support, order processing, marketing, e-commerce, or similar industries is a plus.



SCHEDULE



This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week.



We are looking for someone who can regularly work approximately 7:00 AM–11:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday, or a similar schedule with strong overlap during our U.S. morning business hours.



Because this role supports customer quotes, product presentations, revisions, and other time-sensitive requests, consistent overlap with our business day is important.



We anticipate this position may grow to approximately 40 hours per week within the next 6 months. Applicants should be interested in and available for a potential transition to full-time employment.



GROWTH OF THE ROLE



This position is expected to grow over time.



As your weekly hours increase, your responsibilities may also expand based on the needs of the business, your strengths, and the areas you are able to take ownership of.



The responsibilities listed above reflect what we need help with today, but they are not intended to be a permanent limit on the role.



As you learn our business and become more familiar with our systems, customers, products, and workflow, there may be additional areas you can help manage or eventually take over.



We also expect that having a dedicated Virtual Assistant will allow our business to grow, which may create new responsibilities, systems, and opportunities that do not exist yet.



We value initiative and would welcome someone who recognizes areas where they can help improve our processes, organization, customer follow-up, marketing, or day-to-day operations.



Our goal is to find someone who is interested in becoming a trusted long-term team member, taking increasing ownership of day-to-day processes, and growing with the company as the role develops.



COMPENSATION



Starting compensation is expected to be approximately $5–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience and ability.



There will be opportunities for increased hours, responsibility, and compensation as you learn our business and demonstrate your abilities.



We are not looking for a temporary freelancer. Our goal is to find someone who can become a trusted, long-term member of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send only a generic cover letter.



At the very top of your application, tell us your favorite promotional product or branded item you have ever received.



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your previous virtual assistant, administrative, sales support, customer service, or marketing experience.

2. Have you previously worked in promotional products, printing, apparel, signage, branded merchandise, or a related industry?

3. Have you ever used SAGE? If yes, please describe specifically what you did within SAGE.

4. Have you ever used DecoNetwork? If yes, please describe specifically what you did within DecoNetwork.

5. What other software do you use regularly?

6. Have you used ChatGPT or another AI tool for work? If so, tell us how.

7. Have you created customer quotes, proposals, presentations, or sales follow-up
s before? Please describe your experience.

8. What experience do you have with Adobe Illustrator?

9. Are you comfortable learning how to identify vector versus raster artwork and properly place and size existing vector artwork on artboards or product templates?

10. Tell us about a time you had to learn a new software program or business process.

11. Are you available to regularly work approximately 7:00 AM–11:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday?

12. What hourly rate are you requesting?

13. Are you currently working for any other clients? If so, approximately how many hours per week?

14. This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week but may become a 40-hour-per-week position within approximately 6 months. Would you be interested and available to transition to full-time if offered?

15. What is one area of a small business that you have helped improve, organize, automate, or take ownership of in a previous role?



Candidates who move forward may be asked to complete a short paid skills assessment before we make a final hiring decision.



We are looking for someone we can train, trust, and work with for years. If you are looking for a long-term opportunity where your responsibilities can grow along with the company, we would love to hear from you.

title: Graphic Designer (Apparel) + Shopify Store Assistant
description:
Probation of 1 to 3 months at $500/month base, then a raise based on performance. Hours: 40 hrs/week, with some flexibility on your schedule



About us

XMartial is a combat sports apparel brand (Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, MMA, Muay Thai). We have served over 100,000 customers in 50+ countries with distinctive designs and high-quality gear. We move fast, we ship often, and our designs are the reason people buy from us instead of everyone else.



What this role is

You design our apparel. Rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees: you create the vector artwork, build the print files, and produce the mockups that go live on the store and into our ads.



Design is the core of the job and where most of your week goes. The rest of your time you work as a general store assistant, supporting whatever the store needs that week: uploading and organizing products in Shopify, resizing and preparing images, editing banners, fixing catalog issues, and other hands-on tasks.



This is an independent role. We give you the brief, the references, and the print specs, and trust you to deliver finished, production-ready work without being chased.



What you will do

Apparel design (the main job) + Shopify Store Assistant



Create original vector artwork for all-over-print combat sports apparel: rashguards, shorts, spats, gis, tees.

Build print-ready files that match manufacturer specs: correct dimensions, resolution, bleed, panel placement, and seam alignment across sizes.

Develop colorways and variations of existing designs, and keep whole collections visually consistent.

Work from a brief and from our existing style, while bringing your own ideas for designs you think will sell.



Mockups and visuals

Produce clean, realistic product mockups for the store, ads, and social.

Retouch and edit imagery in Photoshop so the catalog looks consistent and premium.

Create supporting graphics when needed: collection banners, promo images, product-page graphics.



General store assistant work

Upload and organize products in Shopify: images, variants, collections, tidying up messy or duplicate listings.

Prepare and resize assets for different placements across the store and ad channels.

Handle small ongoing tasks that keep the store accurate and up to date.



What we are looking for

Must have

Strong vector design skills in Adobe Illustrator. This is the core skill and we will test it.

Real experience designing apparel for print, ideally all-over sublimation. You understand how a flat file becomes a finished garment.

Photoshop skills for mockups and image retouching.

A portfolio of apparel or graphic design work. Required, no exceptions.

A strong eye for bold, modern design that fits combat sports culture.

Precision. Print files that are off by a few millimeters cost us real money, so details matter.

Willingness to do the non-design store tasks as well. This is not a pure design role.

Good written English and reliable communication.



Nice to have

You train BJJ, MMA, Muay Thai, or wrestling, or you genuinely follow the sport.

Shopify experience.

Comfort using AI tools (image generation, upscaling, background removal) to work faster.

Figma, or experience building tech packs and working directly with manufacturers.



How we work

Before each project we agree on the brief, the references, and the specs, so nothing is fuzzy. We move fast and ship often. Strong applicants get a short paid trial task (one rashguard design plus a mockup) before we finalize.



How to apply

All applications go through our form. We do not accept applications by
 or DM.



Apply here: 



Have your portfolio ready, with at least a few apparel or print designs in it. To show you read this far, the form asks for a keyword: it is GRIP. Applications with the wrong or missing keyword are not reviewed.

title: Senior Executive Assistant to Founder — AI, Operations & Personal Support
description:
I’m the founder of a growing marketplace that helps businesses and individuals find financial professionals.



I’m looking for a senior Executive Assistant who can become my operational right hand.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role, and I am not looking for someone who waits for a daily task list.



I move quickly, have a lot happening at once, and need someone who can bring structure to that environment, keep track of commitments, make good decisions independently, and make sure important things actually get finished.



The goal of this role is simple: reduce the number of things that require me.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You will gradually take ownership of:

- Managing and triaging my inbox

- Drafting and eventually handling routine communications on my behalf

- Calendar management, scheduling, conflicts, and meeting preparation

- Turning meetings, transcripts, voice notes, and ideas into clear tasks and follow-ups

- Making sure things I committed to actually happen

- Following up with customers, vendors, contractors, partners, and other stakeholders

- Travel planning, flights, hotels, transportation, reservations, and itineraries

- Event logistics, guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, and follow-up

- Personal administrative tasks such as gifts, appointments, purchases, and travel

- Tracking invoices, payments, outstanding requests, and administrative loose ends

- Coordinating with contractors and developers when something needs to be fixed or completed

- Supporting outreach and maintaining accurate CRM/task information

- Scheduling approved social content and helping prepare basic assets when needed

- Researching questions and presenting recommendations rather than simply sending me links

- Building systems, SOPs, and processes as you learn how I operate

- Identifying repetitive work that can be improved or eliminated with AI and automation



You will have access to sensitive business and personal information. Judgment, discretion, security, and attention to detail are extremely important.



AI AND AUTOMATION ARE A MAJOR PART OF THIS ROLE



I am specifically looking for someone who is already highly proficient with AI.



Using ChatGPT to rewrite an
 is not enough.



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT and Claude every day and ideally have experience with tools such as Zapier, Make, n8n, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Fireflies, or similar systems.



I want someone who sees a repetitive process and asks: “Why are we still doing this manually?”



Strong candidates should be able to show examples of workflows, automations, systems, agents, or processes they personally built or materially owned.



You do not have to be an engineer. You do need to be resourceful enough to figure things out.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



Ideally, you have:

- 5+ years of professional experience

- 3+ years directly supporting a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive

- At least one role where you stayed long enough to earn significant trust and responsibility

- Experience working directly with U.S.-based executives

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong executive communication skills

- Experience owning inboxes, calendars, follow-up, travel, projects, and confidential information

- Demonstrated use of AI and automation beyond simple content generation

- Strong project-management and organizational ability

- Excellent judgment about what you can handle independently versus what needs to be escalated

- The confidence to manage up and respectfully push back when appropriate

- The ability to work full-time, Monday–Friday, approximately 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with occasional flexibility around travel and events

- Reliable internet, equipment, and a backup plan for power/connectivity



THE PERSONALITY THAT WILL SUCCEED HERE



You are calm when things are moving quickly. You do not become overwhelmed because priorities changed. You do not need every process documented before you can begin. You research before asking questions.



When you encounter a problem, you prefer to come back with: “Here are the three options. I recommend option two because…” rather than: “What do you want me to do?”



You are comfortable reminding a founder about things, following up repeatedly when necessary, protecting their time, and telling them when they are creating too many priorities.



THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF



- You need detailed step-by-step instructions for most tasks

- Your AI experience is primarily asking ChatGPT to draft
s

- You become uncomfortable when priorities change

- You prefer a highly structured corporate environment

- You are uncomfortable receiving direct feedback

- You routinely need your executive to remind you about follow-ups

- You are looking to work multiple overlapping full-time jobs



COMPENSATION



$2,000–$2,500 USD per month, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Full-time, long-term role.



There will be a compensation and performance review after your first 90 days.



Benefits include 10 paid vacation days after 90 days, paid U.S. holidays, and a long-term growth opportunity.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words:



FOUNDER OPS



Applications that do not include those words will not be reviewed.



Please include:



1. Your resume or LinkedIn profile.



2. A 2–3 minute video answering:

- Who is the most demanding founder or executive you have supported?

- What did they trust you to handle independently?

- What is one system, automation, or workflow you personally built or significantly improved?

- What AI and automation tools do you personally use today?

- What are your current work commitments, and when could you begin working full-time Eastern Time?



3. Tell me your desired monthly salary.



4. Answer this scenario in no more than 200 words:



It is Friday at 4:00 PM. Your executive has 15 important unread
s, three people waiting on promised documents, two appointments that still need to be scheduled, and has not given you any additional instructions. What do you do?



Candidates who advance will complete a paid, two-hour work sample designed to test judgment, prioritization, communication, ownership, and practical AI/automation ability.



Finalists will also be asked for professional references.



I am looking for someone who wants to become deeply trusted, learn the business, take on increasing responsibility, and build a long-term working relationship with a founder.

**EZPZ Party Planning**

This position is ideal for someone who is highly skilled in **Canva** and has experience creating **party, event, printable, and digital templates**. You should have a strong eye for design and understand how to create templates that are both beautiful and practical for party planners.



### What You'll Do

* Create template collections and digital products for platforms such as Etsy

* Ensure designs are visually polished, properly aligned, and easy for customers to edit

* Create both digital and print-ready designs

* Work on multiple projects while meeting deadlines

* Follow brand guidelines and design direction

* Collaborate with our team on new product ideas and creative collections



### Required Skills & Experience



**You must have:**



* Proven graphic design experience

* Strong proficiency in **Canva**

* Experience creating **editable Canva templates**

* Experience designing party/event-related graphics or templates

* Strong understanding of typography, color, composition, and layout

* Experience creating print-ready designs

* A strong portfolio showing relevant design work

* Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines



### Preferred Experience



Experience with the following is a major plus:



* Etsy digital products

* Archwall designs

* Floor wraps

* Party backdrops

* Invitations

* Welcome signs

* Favor tags and labels

* Party stationery

* Party games and activities

* T-shirt designs

* Event signage and décor templates



### Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



* Creative with a strong visual eye

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Reliable and responsive

* Able to follow instructions and take feedback well

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines

* Interested in building a long-term working relationship with a growing creative brand



**This is not an entry-level position.** We are looking for someone who can demonstrate professional-quality work and confidently create designs with minimal hand-holding.



### About EZPZ Party Planning



EZPZ Party Planning is an established event planning and education brand serving party planners, event professionals, and creatives.

title: Ecommerce Growth Operator | AI Creative Production, Shopify, Meta Ads & Customer Support
description:
We are building and testing multiple ecommerce brands and are looking for someone who can help us move products from research and testing into profitable growth.



We need someone who understands ecommerce from the customer’s point of view and can help with product research, Shopify product pages, AI-powered ad creative production, competitor research, Meta creative testing, and eventually customer support and day-to-day store operations.



This is not a basic task-based VA role.



We are looking for someone who can think, research, make recommendations, create original advertising assets, organize projects, and help us move quickly based on real market data.



We are currently in a product-testing and growth phase, so the initial role will be **project-based and paid per assignment or creative batch**, with the opportunity to grow into consistent part-time or full-time work as our brands scale.

What success looks like



Within the first few days, you should be able to understand one of our products, study the competitors and advertising landscape, identify strong creative angles, and turn those insights into original ads we can test.



Once a product is approved for testing, you should be able to help prepare:



* High-converting Shopify product pages

* Product offers and bundles

* Static Meta ads

* Short-form video ads

* AI-generated product and lifestyle creative

* UGC-style concepts

* Competitor creative research

* Multiple hooks and creative variations

* Organized launch materials



As products begin generating consistent orders, responsibilities may expand into customer service, order support, returns, supplier communication, and store maintenance.



The goal is to **test quickly, produce more quality creative, protect margins, learn from advertising data, and scale products that show real potential.**



## What you will do



1. Research ecommerce products and competitors across categories such as fashion, accessories, jewelry, home, beauty, pet, automotive, gifting, lifestyle products and other high-potential niches.



2. Use multiple research sources to understand product demand and competitor activity. This may include:



   * Kalodata

   * WinningHunter

   * PipiAds

   *
 Ads Library

   * TikTok Creative Center

   * Organic TikTok

   * Similarweb

   * Google Trends

   * Amazon reviews

   * Competitor websites

   * Instagram

   * Other ecommerce research sources



3. Review competitor:



   * Advertising

   * Offers

   * Pricing

   * Product pages

   * Bundles

   * Reviews

   * Customer language

   * Creative angles

   * Shipping promises

   * Guarantees

   * Upsells



4. Identify the strongest advertising patterns competitors are using and explain why you believe they are working.



5. Turn competitor research into **original advertising concepts** for our brands.



6. Create static ads for Meta using product images, lifestyle imagery, customer benefits, reviews, offers, bundles and strong direct-response hooks.



7. Create short-form video advertisements using product footage and AI tools.



8. Use AI tools to create or enhance:



   * UGC-style ads

   * Product demonstrations

   * Lifestyle footage

   * Product backgrounds

   * Models

   * Image-to-video content

   * Voiceovers

   * B-roll

   * Product scenes

   * Hooks

   * Creative variations



9. Create multiple variations from promising concepts rather than constantly starting from scratch.



10. Build or improve Shopify product pages with:



* Premium product images

* Strong headlines

* Product benefits

* Reviews

* FAQs

* Trust elements

* Shipping information

* Bundle offers

* Upsells

* Mobile-friendly layouts



11. Help prepare products for Meta advertising tests.



12. Review advertising results with us and understand metrics such as:



* CTR

* CPM

* CPC

* Add-to-cart rate

* Checkout rate

* Cost per purchase

* ROAS

* Conversion rate



13. Use advertising performance to decide which creative concepts should be iterated.



14. Keep product research, competitor ads, supplier information, creative files, images, videos and test results organized.



15. As our brands grow, assist with:



* Customer
s

* Tracking questions

* Order issues

* Returns

* Exchanges

* Supplier follow-up

* Shopify order management

* Customer service

* General store maintenance



## Creative standards



We are not looking for random AI-generated content.



Every creative should have a clear reason behind it.



A strong ad should ideally have:



1. Strong visual stopping power



2. A clear hook



3. Obvious product visibility



4. One main customer desire or pain point



5. Strong mobile readability



6. Clear product benefits



7. A compelling offer where appropriate



8. Social proof where available



9. A clear CTA



10. Enough originality that it feels like our brand rather than a copied competitor advertisement



We want someone who understands the difference between:



**a nice-looking piece of content**



and



**an advertisement designed to generate a purchase.**



## Competitor creative research



We will often give you competitor websites and advertising examples.



Your responsibility is to understand **why the advertisement works**, not simply copy it.



For example:



A competitor may be running:



**Buy 1 Get 1 Free + product close-up + customer lifestyle footage**



Your job may be to turn that concept into:



**Our own product footage + our own brand + different environment + original hook + our own offer + original editing**



You must understand the difference between **creative research and creative copying**.



Do not simply download competitor advertisements, change the logo and reuse them.



## Product standards



Products we move forward with should ideally have:



1. Strong visual appeal



2. A clear customer desire or problem



3. Existing demand or social interest



4. Reliable supplier options



5. Enough margin for product cost, shipping and paid advertising



6. Strong creative potential



7. Bundle or upsell possibilities where appropriate



8. Low trademark or intellectual-property risk



9. Reasonable shipping times



10. Enough perceived value to support paid customer acquisition



## Tools and experience we value



Please tell us which of these you have personally used and what you use them for.



**Research**



Kalodata

WinningHunter

PipiAds


 Ads Library

TikTok Creative Center

Organic TikTok research

Similarweb

Google Trends

Amazon reviews

Competitor store analysis



**Shopify and conversion**



Shopify

Shrine

Elixir

Atlas

Kopy

PagePilot

Replo

PageFly

Kaching Bundle

Klaviyo

Loox



**Creative production**



Canva

CapCut

Higgsfield

Kling

Runway

Veo

Midjourney

Adobe Firefly

Gemini

Nano Banana

ChatGPT

Claude

ElevenLabs



**Ads and tracking**



Meta Business Manager

Meta Ads Manager

Meta Pixel

Conversions API

Triple Whale

WeTrack

GA4

Shopify Analytics



You do not need to have used every tool listed.



We care more about your **actual workflow, judgment, quality of work, speed and ability to learn.**



## Initial work structure and compensation



This will initially be a **paid project-based position**, not a fixed monthly salary.



We are currently testing multiple ecommerce products, so the amount of work may change from week to week.



You may be assigned individual projects or creative batches such as:



* 3–5 static ads

* 2–4 short-form video ads

* AI UGC concepts

* Hook variations

* Product-page improvements

* Competitor creative research

* Creative iterations based on winning advertisements



Please provide your pricing for:



1. One static ecommerce advertisement

2. One 15–30 second video advertisement

3. One AI UGC-style advertisement

4. A batch of 4 static ads + 2 video ads

5. Your hourly rate for Shopify or customer-support work if needed



If the relationship works well and our brands continue growing, this can become a consistent part-time or full-time role with increased responsibilities.



## Customer support



Customer support will **not necessarily be the main responsibility at the beginning**.



Initially, the priority will be ecommerce creative production, product testing support and Shopify work.



As order volume grows, we may also need assistance with:



* Customer
s

* “Where is my order?” requests

* Tracking updates

* Returns

* Exchanges

* Refund requests

* Address changes

* Supplier follow-up

* Order issues



Experience with ecommerce customer support is therefore a strong bonus.



## Trial



Shortlisted applicants will complete a **paid trial assignment**.



You may receive:



* One product

* One product page

* Product images

* Competitor advertisements

* Competitor website

* Creative references



You may then be asked to produce:



**1 original static Meta ad*



and



**1 original 15–30 second video ad**



We are not looking for copies of the competitor's advertisements.



We want to see whether you understand the underlying strategy and can turn it into something original that we can actually test.



## How to apply



Start your proposal with:



# **ECOM OPERATOR**



Then answer the following:



1. How many ecommerce products or brands have you personally worked on?



2. Show us 3–5 ecommerce advertisements you personally created.



3. Include at least one static advertisement.



4. Include at least one video advertisement.



5. Include at least one AI-assisted advertisement if available.



6. Explain exactly what part of each advertisement you personally created.



7. Which AI tools do you currently use for image and video production?



8. Have you personally used
 Ads Library, WinningHunter, PipiAds, Kalodata or TikTok Creative Center?



9. Explain how you research competitor advertisements before creating your own version.



10. If we gave you 10 competitor ads and one product page, how would you decide which creative concepts to test first?



11. What Shopify themes, page builders or apps have you worked with?



12. Have you managed ecommerce customer service, returns or order issues before?



13. What Meta advertising metrics do you understand?



14. How quickly could you deliver:



* 4 static ads

* 2 video ads

* 3 additional hooks



15. Give us your price for:



* 1 static ad

* 1 video ad

* 4 statics + 2 videos

* Hourly Shopify/customer-support work



16. What hours are you normally available and what timezone are you in?



17. Confirm that you are willing to complete a **paid trial assignment**.



Generic applications will not be considered.



We are looking for **real examples, real process, clear thinking and someone who wants to grow with an ecommerce operation long term.*

• Search for a multiplayer match

• Enter and remain in the lobby

• Monitor the player counter

• Leave the lobby BEFORE the match starts

• Search for another lobby

• Repeat the process throughout the working period



The purpose is to promote a service displayed directly in the PSN username.



Training will be provided. You will receive a complete instructional video, and we will have a 30-minute video call where I will personally demonstrate exactly what you need to do and answer your questions.

description:

 and Instagram), with the potential to expand to additional platforms as needed.

Set up, monitor, and optimize campaigns, audiences, budgets, placements, and creative performance.

*What We’re Looking For*



Proven experience managing paid social advertising campaigns, particularly on Meta Ads Manager.

Experience with lead generation and conversion-focused campaigns.

Previous experience working with healthcare, wellness, medical, or other regulated industries is highly preferred.

Strong understanding of audience targeting, retargeting, campaign optimization, and A/B testing.

Ability to analyze data and translate performance into actionable recommendations.

Experience managing campaigns with varying budgets and client goals.

Familiarity with tracking, pixels, conversion events, and campaign attribution.

Strong communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and manage priorities within a limited weekly time commitment.

Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of your area of expertise.

Time Commitment & Compensation

title: GTM & Sales Coordinator
description:
The Role: WatchDog Security is looking for a proactive, highly organized GTM & Sales Coordinator to become the day-to-day coordination point for our commercial pipeline. We already run inbound and outbound campaigns that generate conversations. Your job is to make sure those conversations are handled well, followed up consistently, tracked properly, and moved toward the right next step.



This is an early-stage role working closely with the founders. It combines inbound sales support, CRM ownership, proposal follow-up, warm prospecting, partner/customer coordination and practical GTM projects. It is not a cold-calling role.



What We Are Looking For



Required:

-Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable representing a North American B2B technology company.

-Strong organization and follow-through across many small conversations and deadlines.

-Good judgment: able to read context, recognize what matters, and ask before making unsupported claims.

-Experience in sales support, SDR/BDR work, customer support/success, lead generation, executive/virtual assistance, sales operations or a similar client-facing coordination role.

-Comfort using a CRM such as Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce or Dynamics.

-Comfort researching prospects using LinkedIn and/or Sales Navigator.

-Self-directed remote work habits and reliable communication.

-Comfort working in an early-stage environment where processes are improving quickly.



Nice to Have

-B2B SaaS experience.

-Experience supporting founders or small business owners.

-Experience with MSPs/MSSPs, cybersecurity, compliance/GRC or technology services.

-Experience coordinating webinars, customer feedback or lightweight marketing/GTM projects.



What You Will Own



-Monitor and respond to appropriate inbound LinkedIn and
 conversations during working hours.

-Follow up with prospects, open opportunities and proposals so worthwhile conversations do not disappear due to lack of follow-through.

-Maintain Pipedrive for legitimate opportunities, including accurate stage, notes, next action and next-action date.

-Re-engage suitable past prospects and opportunities using context rather than generic mass messages.

-Research strong prospects and partners within the founders' existing LinkedIn network and start natural, relevant conversations.

-Coordinate partner/MSP and customer follow-ups, feedback requests and meeting scheduling.

-Prepare simple pre-call context and own the commercial follow-up after selected sales/partner calls.

--Help with practical GTM projects during available capacity - for example webinar coordination, customer/partner feedback campaigns, testimonial outreach, prospect research or content/social coordination.

-Escalate technical, legal, pricing, contract or strategic questions instead of guessing.



What This Role Is NOT



-No high-volume cold calling.

-No expectation to be a cybersecurity expert on Day 1.



What Success Looks Like

-Inbound: Legitimate inbound is responded to promptly and professionally.

-Follow-up Due follow-ups happen without a founder remembering or prompting them.
