title: Virtual General Manager / Senior Operations Manager
description:
We are a growing home-services company based in Texas, USA, specializing primarily in air duct cleaning, HVAC cleaning and indoor air quality services, mold-related services, and restoration work.



Our business operates with field technicians who travel to customers’ homes and businesses every day. Our office team is responsible for answering incoming calls, booking jobs, following up with leads, coordinating technicians, handling customers, ordering materials, working with vendors, and keeping the entire operation organized.



We are continuing to grow, and we are looking for an exceptional Virtual General Manager / Senior Operations Manager who can become the owner’s right hand and eventually take responsibility for much of the company’s day-to-day operations.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant position.

This is NOT simply a customer service or call-answering position.

This is NOT a traditional 8-hour-a-day, Monday-Friday job.



We are looking for an extremely capable, intelligent, resourceful, and dependable person.



We don’t need someone who waits for instructions all day.



We need someone who can see a problem, understand it, research it when necessary, make a good decision, take action, and follow through until the problem is solved.



Our goal is to find someone we can eventually trust to run the daily operations of the company with minimal supervision.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will be involved in nearly every part of the business, including:



* Managing the daily schedule of technicians, jobs, and appointments

* Answering and managing customer calls professionally

* Following up with new leads, estimates, and existing customers

* Negotiating with customers and helping close sales

* Coordinating technicians throughout the day

* Making sure technicians arrive at jobs on time and jobs are completed efficiently

* Handling customer complaints and finding solutions

* Identifying operational problems before they become bigger problems

* Ordering equipment, materials, tools, and supplies

* Managing relationships with existing vendors

* Finding better vendors, suppliers, and business partners

* Opening new supplier and vendor accounts

* Keeping track of unfinished tasks and making sure nothing falls through the cracks

* Monitoring employee and technician performance

* Improving company systems, procedures, and organization

* Researching solutions independently when you don’t know the answer

* Helping recruit and manage employees as the company grows

* Working directly with the owner on company growth and daily decision-making

* Taking responsibility for getting things done instead of simply reporting problems to the owner



The Person We’re Looking For



Intelligence, common sense, and problem-solving ability are extremely important for this position.



We’re looking for someone who:



* Thinks like an operator and business owner

* Is exceptionally sharp and learns quickly

* Has excellent judgment and common sense

* Takes initiative without constantly waiting for instructions

* Can solve complicated problems independently

* Is extremely organized

* Remembers details and follows through

* Can manage many things happening at the same time

* Communicates professionally and confidently

* Can manage employees and technicians

* Can negotiate with customers and help close sales

* Is comfortable making decisions

* Knows when to make a decision independently and when something truly needs the owner’s attention

* Takes accountability for results, not just completed tasks

* Can be trusted with increasing levels of responsibility



We do not want someone whose mentality is:



“Tell me what to do and I will do it.”



We want someone whose mentality is:



“I understand what needs to be accomplished. I will figure out how to make it happen.”



Requirements



* Previous experience as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Office Manager, Executive Operations Manager, or similar leadership position

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities

* Excellent customer service skills

* Strong sales and negotiation skills

* Experience managing employees, schedules, and daily operations

* Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software quickly

* Ability to research and find answers independently

* Ability to work with limited supervision

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional workspace

* Long-term commitment



Experience with a U.S.-based home-service, HVAC, restoration, construction, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, or similar field-service company is a major advantage.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires 7-day-a-week availability.



This does not necessarily mean you will be actively working every hour, seven days a week. However, this is a senior operational position, and you must have the flexibility to respond when important situations require your attention.



We are not looking for someone who wants to work a strict shift, clock out, and completely disconnect from the business.



We need someone who understands that being responsible for operations sometimes requires handling an urgent customer, technician, scheduling, or operational issue outside normal working hours.



The regular working schedule, time off, and exact availability expectations will be discussed during the interview.



Compensation & Growth



Starting Salary: $1,200 USD per month



This is the starting salary, not the maximum salary.



We want someone who can grow with the company.



As you prove that you can independently manage more of the operation, solve problems, manage employees, improve performance, and reduce the amount of day-to-day involvement required from the owner, your compensation can increase.



There is significant long-term growth potential for the right person.



The more responsibility you can successfully take off the owner’s shoulders, the more valuable you become to the company.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career and eventually become one of the company’s key leaders.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are not looking for hundreds of average applications.



We are looking for one exceptional person.



When submitting your application, you MUST include a brief explanation answering the following:



“Why do you believe you are the best person for this position, and why should we trust you to eventually help run the company?”



Tell us about relevant experience you’ve had, difficult problems you’ve solved, teams or operations you’ve managed, and what makes you different from other applicants.



Generic answers will not help you. We want to understand how you think.



Applications that do not include this explanation will NOT be considered.



If you’re simply looking for another virtual assistant job where you answer calls and complete assigned tasks, please do not apply.



If you’re highly intelligent, ambitious, resourceful, dependable, and want the opportunity to become the right hand of a business owner and grow into a major leadership position, we want to hear from you.

title: Content Writer & Researcher
description:
We're looking for creative, naturally curious writers to join our team for a long-term position.



This is not a traditional SEO writing role.



We're not looking for someone whose writing process is simply checking keywords, analyzing the top-ranking articles, and producing another version of what's already there.



We'll provide the topics and direction. Your job is to take an unfamiliar subject, research it thoroughly, find interesting information and angles, and turn what you discover into an article that's genuinely useful and worth reading.



What We're Looking For

Strong, natural writing

Excellent research skills

Genuine curiosity and willingness to learn

Creative and independent thinking

Ability to make unfamiliar or technical subjects interesting

Good judgment when evaluating sources and information

Attention to detail and fact-checking

Ability to explain complicated ideas clearly

Ability to take feedback and improve

Reliability and consistency



You don't need to be an expert in any particular niche.



In fact, being comfortable researching subjects you've never encountered before is an important part of the job.



We're especially interested in writers who naturally ask questions, go down research rabbit holes, and look beyond the first few results they find online.



What the Work Looks Like



We'll provide you with topics that we've already identified and researched for their potential.



From there, we expect you to think like a writer and researcher rather than simply follow an SEO template.



That might mean finding original sources, studies, reports, datasets, expert opinions, community discussions, firsthand information, or other useful material depending on the topic.



The goal isn't to write an article just because a search engine wants one.



We want to create articles that deserve to rank because they're genuinely useful and interesting.



Using AI



AI tools can be part of your workflow, but we're not looking for someone who generates an article with AI and lightly edits the output.



The research, thinking, judgment, fact-checking, and final quality of your work need to be yours.

title: Experienced Australian Solar & Battery Sales Consultant / Closer
description:
We are an established Western Australian-owned electrical company based in Perth. With over 12 years of industry experience and more than 400 five-star customer reviews, we directly supply and install solar panels, battery systems, ducted air conditioning and other electrical solutions.



We are seeking an experienced Philippines-based sales consultant who has previously sold solar, batteries or ducted air conditioning or similar home-improvement products to Australian homeowners.



This is a genuine sales-closing position—not a general virtual assistant or basic appointment-setting role.



The Role

You will manage primarily warm inbound enquiries from Western Australian homeowners and take ownership of the customer journey from initial contact through to sale.



Your responsibilities will include:



Contacting new leads quickly and professionally.

Understanding the customer’s electricity usage, property, existing solar system, battery requirements, budget and timeframe.

Qualifying homeowners and identifying genuine sales opportunities.

Explaining suitable solar, battery and air-conditioning solutions clearly.

Presenting approved pricing, proposals and payment options.

Handling objections and competitor comparisons professionally.

Following up quotations consistently until the customer makes a decision.

Closing sales and collecting deposits through the approved company process.

Maintaining accurate notes, follow-ups and pipeline stages in GoHighLevel.

Coordinating with our Perth sales, technical and installation teams.

Providing a professional customer experience throughout the sales journey.

Cross-selling solar, batteries and ducted air conditioning after completing product training.



Essential Experience



To be considered, you must have:



At least two year of experience selling to Australian customers.

Proven experience personally closing residential solar, battery or -air-conditioning or related home-improvement sales.

Strong communication, objection-handling and negotiation skills.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Confidence speaking naturally with Australian homeowners.

Experience managing warm leads and conducting persistent follow-ups.

Experience using a CRM system.

Reliable internet, a professional headset and a quiet home-working environment.

Availability to work full-time during Perth/Philippines daytime business hours.



Australian residential solar or battery sales experience will be strongly preferred.



Please Do Not Apply If

Your experience is limited to general customer service or virtual-assistant work.

You have only booked appointments and have never personally closed sales.

You cannot provide clear information about your previous results.



What We Provide

Warm inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.

An established Australian brand with a Perth showroom and installation team.

Product, pricing and Western Australian market training.

Competitive base salary based on verified experience.

Attractive commission and performance incentives.

Long-term, stable work with opportunities to progress 



How to Apply



Please include your updated CV and answer every question below:



How many years have you worked in Australian sales?

Which Australian companies or campaigns have you worked with?

Have you sold solar, batteries, air conditioning or other home-improvement products?

Were you an appointment setter, sales closer or full-cycle sales consultant?

How many sales did you personally close each week or month?

What was your approximate closing rate?

Were your leads inbound, warm outbound, cold or self-generated?

Which Australian states did you sell into?

Which CRM and quotation platforms have you used?

Did you personally present proposals, discuss finance and collect deposits?

Can a previous manager verify your employment and performance?

What base salary and commission structure are you expecting?



Please also provide a 60–90 second voice or video introduction covering:



Your Australian sales experience.

Your strongest result as a salesperson.

How you would respond if a homeowner said: “Your competitor is $2,000 cheaper. Why should I choose your company?”



Applications that do not answer these questions or include the requested introduction will not be shortlisted.



If you have genuine experience closing Australian residential solar, battery or air-conditioning customers and want a stable long-term opportunity with a growing Perth company, we would like to hear from you.

title: FINANCE CONTROLLER
description:
Lead cross-functional communication and conduct in-depth analytical reviews to ensure accuracy, completeness, and proper approval of material financial items.



Manage the local controllership function, providing oversight and guidance to FinOps teams across P2P, R2R, O2C, Tax, Audit, Fixed Assets, and Consolidation.



Ensure timely and accurate US GAAP/IFRS accounting, month-end close, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations by leveraging offshore resources.



Oversee monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close and consolidation, including review of management and statutory reporting packages.



Review and approve payment proposals prepared by FinOps, including procure-to-pay and intercompany settlements.



Act as primary point of contact for local banking and treasury matters, coordinating with local banks and group treasury; approve payroll, intercompany transactions, and other critical payments.



Manage cash flow planning and cash management to ensure liquidity and operational continuity.



Lead statutory reporting, tax accounting, and audit processes, coordinating with FinOps teams, internal auditors, external auditors, and tax agents to meet regulatory deadlines.

title: PROPERTY DAMAGE SPECIALISTS
description:
Champion Injury Attorneys is seeking an experienced Property Damage Specialist to manage our clients’ property damage claims from beginning to end.  In your down time assist case managers.  



This is a dedicated property damage position supporting our case managers and clients. We are looking for someone who already understands plaintiff side property damage claims and can independently move files forward without waiting to be told what the next step is.



The right person understands that property damage is often one of the first serious problems a client faces after a collision. Our clients may be without transportation, dealing with a totaled vehicle, facing storage charges, waiting on repairs, or trying to understand an insurance company’s position. We want someone who takes ownership of those problems, communicates clearly, and works toward a prompt and favorable resolution.



Responsibilities

The Property Damage Specialist will be responsible for managing assigned property damage claims from beginning through final resolution, including:

• Open and manage first party and third party property damage claims

• Communicate directly with clients regarding the status of their vehicles and property damage claims

• Communicate and negotiate with insurance adjusters

• Obtain photographs, estimates, repair information, police reports, vehicle information, and supporting documentation

• Coordinate vehicle inspections and appraisals

• Assist clients with repair claims and repair facility issues

• Handle total loss claims from beginning through resolution

• Review total loss evaluations for accuracy

• Review vehicle valuations, comparable vehicles, mileage, options, condition, and other factors affecting value

• Challenge inaccurate or unreasonable total loss valuations when appropriate

• Negotiate property damage settlements

• Assist clients with rental vehicles

• Address rental extensions and unreasonable rental termination issues

• Handle loss of use claims when appropriate

• Address towing and storage issues

• Work to prevent unnecessary storage charges and avoidable delays

• Communicate with body shops, tow yards, rental companies, lienholders, insurance companies, and other parties involved in the property damage claim

• Help clients obtain payment once the property damage claim has been resolved

• Follow through until repairs, total loss payments, rentals, and related property damage issues are completed

• Prepare and timely file California DMV SR 1 Reports of Traffic A
 Occurring in California when required

• Prepare and submit SR 6 documentation when appropriate

• Monitor DMV related deadlines and confirm required filings have been completed

• Maintain accurate file notes, documentation, follow up dates, and status updates in the case management system

• Keep the assigned case manager informed of significant developments

• Immediately escalate unusual coverage issues, liability disputes, unreasonable carrier conduct, or other issues requiring case manager or attorney involvement

• Confirm that the property damage portion of the file is properly completed before closing it out

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate has:

• At least 2 years of successful property damage experience at a plaintiff personal injury law firm

• Strong knowledge of California automobile property damage claims

• Experience handling both repairable vehicles and total losses

• Experience reviewing and challenging total loss evaluations

• Knowledge of rental claims and loss of use

• Experience handling towing and storage issues

• Experience communicating and negotiating with insurance adjusters

• Familiarity with California DMV a
 reporting requirements, including SR 1 filings

• Strong follow through and organizational skills

• The ability to manage multiple active property damage claims at the same time

• Excellent client communication skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• The judgment to recognize when something does not look right and investigate it

• The ability to work independently while communicating effectively with case managers

• A strong sense of urgency when a client is without transportation or facing rental, towing, storage, repair, or total loss problems

What Success Looks Like

We are not looking for someone whose job is simply to make follow up calls.

A successful Property Damage Specialist:

• Knows what needs to happen next on every assigned claim

• Does not allow property damage files to sit without action

• Identifies problems before they become larger problems

• Keeps clients informed throughout the process

• Pushes insurance companies when claims are unnecessarily delayed

• Carefully reviews total loss valuations instead of simply accepting the insurance company’s number

• Protects clients from unnecessary rental, towing, storage, and repair related problems

• Makes sure required DMV filings are completed timely

• Documents the file thoroughly

• Keeps case managers informed without requiring them to manage the property damage process

• Takes ownership of the claim until it is actually resolved

Required Experience

At least 2 years of experience successfully handling property damage claims for a plaintiff personal injury law firmis required.

Prior insurance adjusting experience is helpful but not required.

REMOTE Position

This is a dedicated Property Damage Specialist position supporting the personal injury case management team at Champion Injury Attorneys.

title: Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference
description:
## Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference



We are an automotive parts company looking for a reliable full-time remote team member to help our sales team identify the correct automotive parts quickly and accurately.



### Main Responsibilities



* Search automotive parts by VIN, vehicle details, engine code, and model

* Identify correct OEM / OE part numbers

* Find aftermarket alternatives and cross-reference part numbers

* Work with TecDoc and other automotive parts catalogs

* Compare part numbers between different suppliers and manufacturers

* Update product and supplier mappings in our ERP system

* Prepare information for our sales team so they can quote customers quickly

* Check unclear or difficult vehicle/part matches

* Keep records organized and accurate

* Report when there are multiple possible parts or when you are not 100% sure



### Very Important



Accuracy is more important than speed.



We do not want someone who guesses.



If there are two possible parts for a vehicle, you must clearly report that further verification is required.



### Experience We Prefer



Experience with any of the following is a big advantage:



* TecDoc

* OEM / OE automotive part numbers

* VIN lookup

* EPC systems

* Parts catalogues

* Bosch

* MANN

* MAHLE

* Denso

* Valeo

* VAG / ETKA

* BMW ETK

* Mercedes EPC

* Toyota / Hyundai / Kia / Japanese or European vehicle catalogues

* Automotive spare parts e-commerce or wholesale companies



### Work Style



This is not a customer service role.



You will mainly work as a back-office automotive parts research specialist supporting our sales team.



You must be:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching difficult cases

* Able to follow procedures

* Comfortable using Excel / Google Sheets / ERP systems

* Honest when you are unsure about a part match



### Working Hours



Full-time preferred.



Working hours should overlap with Israel business hours for at least part of the day.



Israel time is UTC+2 / UTC+3 depending on daylight saving time.



### Salary



Starting salary: **USD $650–$800 per month**, depending on automotive parts experience and skill level.



Salary can increase after the probation period based on accuracy, productivity, reliability, and ability to work independently.



### Application Test



Please do not send a generic application.



In your application, answer these questions:



1. Have you worked with automotive spare parts before? Please explain.

2. Have you used TecDoc? For how long?

3. Which EPC or automotive catalog systems have you used?

4. Are you comfortable finding OE/OEM numbers using a VIN?

5. Which vehicle brands do you know best?

6. Give one example of how you would verify that a part definitely fits a specific vehicle.

7. What is your expected monthly salary?

8. Can you work full-time?

9. What hours can you work in Philippine time?



Please start your application with the words:



**PARTS RESEARCH**



Applications without these words may not be reviewed.

title: Ecommerce Store Manager & Developer — Build, Launch and Run an Online Store
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I run a registered business and I am launching an online store. You will be a direct

hire working 100% remotely from the Philippines. No agency, no middleman — you report

to me directly.



I need ONE person who owns the store end to end. Not a specialist for each task.



This will not stay limited to one store or one product line. The business is expanding,

and the right person will take on more as it grows.





WORKING HOURS — FLEXIBLE



Sunday to Thursday. Friday and Saturday off.



My core window is 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM GMT+4

= 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Philippine time.



You choose your daily commitment: 4, 6, or 8 hours per day — tell me what works for

you and we agree on it together. What I do need is a minimum 4-hour overlap inside my

core window, so we can actually talk during the day and not only by message.





PAY



USD 3.65 – 4.90 per hour, depending on years of experience and proven skills.



  4 hrs/day  =  USD 292 – 390 per month

  6 hrs/day  =  USD 438 – 585 per month

  8 hrs/day  =  USD 585 – 780 per month



Two-week PAID trial first. Payment is transferred at the end of the trial so you can

confirm the system works before we commit long term. I pay on time, every time.





GROWTH AND COMMITMENT



The starting rate is a starting point, not a ceiling. It is reviewed and can be

increased after the first few months — but that increase is earned, not automatic.

What earns it is simple: how reliable you are, how hard you actually work, and whether

I can depend on you without checking behind you.



I am not hiring for a project. I am hiring for the long term. This store is being built

to grow, and I want the person who builds it to still be running it years from now —

with more responsibility and more pay as it scales.



If you are looking for something short term, or a placeholder while you wait for

something better, please do not apply. I would rather wait for the right person than

replace the wrong one in three months.





═══════════════════════════════════════════



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. BUILD THE STORE

- Develop and launch the store (Shopify preferred; open to other platforms if you can

  justify why)

- DESIGN IT PROPERLY. I do not want a default theme with the demo content swapped out.

  A template is a starting point, not the finished job. Show me you can shape layout,

  spacing, typography and visual hierarchy into something that looks like a real brand.

- Set up domain and business
 from scratch (DNS, records, mailbox, connect to the

  store)



2. PAYMENT AND CHECKOUT

- Research and recommend the right payment gateway for my market, then integrate it.

  I have not locked one in — if you have experience choosing between gateways, tell me

  how you would decide.

- Set up Cash on Delivery — it is essential in my market

- Configure checkout end to end and test the full flow yourself before it goes live



3. SEO AND PRODUCT COPY — THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART

- Keyword research: find the terms real buyers search for, not generic ones

- Write product titles, descriptions and meta content built around those keywords

- On-page SEO: URLs, alt text, collection pages, internal linking

- The copy must do two jobs at once: rank in search AND convert the reader into a buyer



4. DAILY OPERATIONS

- Stock levels and inventory accuracy

- Order processing and fulfillment follow-through

- Pricing and margin maintenance

- Product entry: variants, options, images, collections, metafields

- Reorder BEFORE we run out — I should never hear "we're out of stock" from a customer

  first



5. PROCUREMENT (PHASE 2)

Phase 1 products are sourced locally. After that you will handle:

- Placing orders with international suppliers

- Following the order through production and dispatch

- Managing the
 thread with suppliers and freight forwarders until the shipment

  arrives

- Keeping me updated with a clear status, not a forwarded
 chain



6. REPORTING

You will work against KPIs agreed at the start of the trial. Weekly reporting is part

of the role.





═══════════════════════════════════════════



SKILLS I AM LOOKING FOR



ESSENTIAL

- Shopify development: theme customization, sections, page structure, page speed

  (basic Liquid is a strong plus)

- Visual design ability — a page that looks designed, not assembled

- Payment gateway research, integration and checkout configuration

- Keyword research with real tools (Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Keyword Planner)

- SEO copywriting for product and collection pages

- Product data structure: variants, options, collections, metafields, tags

- Inventory, order management and reorder discipline

- Domain, DNS and business
 setup

- Strong written English — you will write everything the customer reads



STRONG PLUS

- Conversion rate optimization: product page layout, trust signals, checkout friction,

  cart abandonment recovery

- Mobile-first optimization — most of my traffic will be phones

- Product photography workarounds: AI-generated visuals, mockups, lifestyle imagery

- Image optimization: compression, alt text, consistent aspect ratios

- Klaviyo or
 flows: welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back

- GA4, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Search Console

- Shipping and fulfillment configuration: rates, zones, courier integration, tracking

  notifications

- Returns, refunds and customer service workflows

- Content and blog SEO — building organic traffic without paid ads

- Supplier communication and international freight follow-up

- Reporting: turning store data into a weekly summary I can act on

- Experience with restricted or sensitive advertising categories on Meta or Google



TOOLS I EXPECT YOU TO BE COMFORTABLE WITH

Shopify admin, Google Sheets or Excel, Canva or equivalent, a keyword research tool,

and one project or task tracker.





IMPORTANT — READ THIS

Some of what I sell falls under restricted advertising categories on Meta and Google,

so paid ads will be limited. Growth will come from SEO, content and
. If you have

handled restricted categories before, say so. If you have not, say that honestly — I

will not hold a gap in experience against you, but I will hold dishonesty against you.

I will share the full details of the product range with shortlisted applicants.





═══════════════════════════════════════════



TO APPLY — include ALL of the following:



1. Start the first line of your reply with the word ORBIT

2. Your portfolio

3. Links to AT LEAST 2 live stores you have actually built or managed. Live and public

   — not password-protected, not practice stores. Tell me exactly what you did on each.

4. One product description you wrote yourself, pasted directly into your reply

5. Your hourly rate in USD

6. How many hours per day you can commit (4, 6 or 8), and confirmation that you can

   overlap at least 4 hours inside 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Philippine time, Sunday to Thursday

7. Answer this: what is the first thing you do when the first order comes in?



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.

title: JOB TITLE: UK Debt & Insolvency Caseworker / Accountant – Creditor Negotiation and Bankruptcy Support
description:
JOB TITLE: UK Debt & Insolvency Caseworker / Accountant – Creditor Negotiation and Bankruptcy Support



We are seeking an experienced professional to review a personal and/or business debt situation in the United Kingdom and help develop the most appropriate way forward.



The work may involve negotiating affordable arrangements with creditors, reviewing company and personal liabilities, preparing financial information, and assessing whether bankruptcy or another formal insolvency option may be necessary.



Northern Ireland experience is strongly preferred, as its insolvency procedures differ from those in England and Wales.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Review personal and business debts, assets, income and expenditure

- Create a complete creditor and liability schedule

- Separate personal liabilities from limited-company liabilities

- Identify urgent debts, secured debts and priority creditors

- Review correspondence, statements and creditor demands

- Prepare realistic income-and-expenditure and affordability calculations

- Help draft professional letters and settlement proposals to creditors

- Assist with negotiating payment plans, reduced settlements or temporary holds

- Explain the likely consequences of bankruptcy and other UK debt solutions

- Identify which matters require a UK-authorised insolvency practitioner, solicitor or regulated debt adviser

- Prepare an organised case file for any formal insolvency consultation

- Maintain complete confidentiality and securely handle financial documents

- Provide a clear written action plan with deadlines and recommended next steps



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Demonstrable experience with UK personal debt, business debt or insolvency cases

- Strong knowledge of UK creditor procedures and debt-recovery practices

- Experience preparing statements of affairs, creditor schedules and affordability assessments

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Meticulous, confidential and non-judgmental

- Able to distinguish between administrative support and advice that legally requires UK authorisation



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



- Experience with Northern Ireland bankruptcy and insolvency procedures

- UK accounting, bookkeeping, debt-advice or insolvency qualifications

- Previous employment with a UK accountancy practice, insolvency firm, debt-advice organisation or creditor-negotiation service

- Experience with director guarantees, tax debts, Bounce Back Loans, VAT liabilities and dissolved or insolvent companies

- Existing access to a qualified UK insolvency practitioner or solicitor for regulated matters



IMPORTANT



This role requires genuine UK experience. Please do not apply if your experience relates only to US, Philippine or other non-UK debt systems.



The successful applicant must not claim to provide regulated legal, financial or insolvency advice unless appropriately qualified and authorised in the United Kingdom. Where necessary, you will help prepare the information required for review by a UK-authorised professional.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following:



1. How many UK debt or insolvency cases have you handled?

2. Do you have specific experience with Northern Ireland?

3. What formal qualifications or professional memberships do you hold?

4. Have you worked with personal debts, limited-company debts, or both?

5. Have you dealt with HMRC debts, VAT, Bounce Back Loans or personal guarantees?

6. Describe one UK case in which you helped arrange creditor settlements or prepare for bankruptcy.

7. Which parts of this work can you personally undertake, and which would require a UK-authorised insolvency practitioner or solicitor?

8. What is your preferred hourly rate and availability?



Please begin your application with the words “UK DEBT EXPERIENCE” so we know you have read the full post.



This may begin as a short-term assessment and case-organisation project, with the possibility of continuing work depending on experience and results.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
We are looking for a BDR / SDR who can help us streamline and manage our end-to-end lead generation pipeline, from identifying and sourcing leads to nurturing and tracking them effectively in Salesforce.



The candidate will be responsible for managing leads coming from different sources, including lead generation tools, LinkedIn, Dripify/Pardot campaigns,
 campaigns, existing prospect databases, referrals, and our previous lead lists. All leads should be properly organized, tracked, and maintained within Salesforce as the central CRM.



The role will include prospecting, calling leads, sending personalized
s, managing follow-ups, nurturing prospects, and booking qualified meetings. The candidate should ensure that leads are consistently followed up with and that potential opportunities do not get lost due to a lack of engagement.



We are looking for someone who is well-versed in market research and targeted prospecting. Before setting up campaigns, the candidate should be able to study the market, understand our target audience, identify the right industries, companies, and decision-makers, and create campaigns that are focused and relevant rather than generic mass outreach.

The candidate may also be asked to participate in digital marketing activities, including supporting campaign planning, content promotion, social media outreach, webinar/event promotions, and other marketing initiatives that contribute to lead generation and brand awareness.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone who understands the complete lead generation lifecycle and can proactively recommend improvements to our existing setup, including the right processes, tools, automation, campaign structure, lead qualification, nurturing strategy, and Salesforce tracking.



The ideal candidate should be able to manage and improve the complete process:

Market Research → Target Account Identification → Lead Generation → Campaign Setup → Outreach → Calling &
 Follow-ups → Salesforce Tracking → Lead Nurturing → Qualification → Meeting Booking → Opportunity Handover



Experience with Salesforce CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify/Pardot,

Work from home

title: Tanero Engineering Team — 10 Specialized Full-Time Roles
description:
Tanero is building a small, highly specialized engineering team.



We are NOT hiring immediately. We are currently identifying and evaluating exceptional candidates, with hiring expected to begin in approximately 3 months.



This is not a general developer recruitment post.



We are building a team of exactly 10 specialized full-time engineers. Each person will own a major area of the product and will be expected to work independently, think deeply, use modern AI coding tools, and take responsibility for the quality of their area.



We are looking for engineers who want long-term ownership of a product, not freelancers looking for short projects.



REMOTE

Full-time

40 hours per week

Long-term

Direct hire

Work from home



Claude Code, Codex, and other professional AI development tools will be provided by Tanero.



AI tools are expected to increase your speed, but you remain responsible for architecture, decisions, code quality, testing, security, and production reliability.



We do NOT accept “the AI wrote it” as an explanation for poor work.



---



AVAILABLE POSITIONS



You MUST apply for ONE of the following positions.



Applications that do not clearly identify one of these 10 roles will not be reviewed.



1. PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ARCHITECT / ENGINEERING LEAD

   Salary: USD $1,500/month



You will be responsible for the overall technical architecture of Tanero.



We are looking for someone with strong experience in:



* large software systems

* architecture and system boundaries

* TypeScript / Node.js

* backend systems

* distributed or event-driven systems

* databases and state management

* API architecture

* code review

* technical debt reduction

* reliability and scalability



You must be capable of understanding an existing large production codebase before proposing changes.



We are NOT looking for someone whose first reaction is “rewrite everything.”



You must be able to identify what should remain, what should be refactored, what should be replaced, and what should be removed.



---



2. AGENT RUNTIME / DEEPSEEK HARNESS ENGINEER

   Salary: USD $1,500/month



This is NOT an n8n, Zapier, Make.com, or simple workflow automation position.



You will work deeply with agent runtimes and eventually DeepSeek Harness or equivalent agent infrastructure.



Strong knowledge expected in several of the following:



* LLM agent loops

* tool calling

* agent orchestration

* persistent sessions/state

* background jobs

* subagents

* retries and failure recovery

* permission systems

* sandboxing

* context management

* event-driven systems

* long-running tasks

* model adapters/routing

* TypeScript / Node.js

* Python

* production AI systems



Experience with LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, CrewAI or similar systems is useful, but using a framework alone does NOT qualify you.



We want someone who understands what happens underneath the framework.



---



3. SMART TOOLS / AUTONOMOUS AGENT ENGINEER

   Salary: USD $1,400/month



You will own Tanero's autonomous client interaction and qualification system.



This role requires strong understanding of:



* autonomous agents

* persistent state

* long-running conversations

* tool execution

* client context

* event processing

* retries

* duplicate prevention

* background execution

* decision systems

* AI evaluation

* failure handling

* production reliability



This is NOT workflow automation.



If your primary experience is connecting OpenAI to Gmail using n8n, Zapier, Make or GoHighLevel, this position is not for you.



---



4. ORBIT / AGENT PRODUCT ENGINEER

   Salary: USD $1,300/month



You will own Tanero's on-demand digital execution experience.



Strong experience desired in:



* AI agents

* multi-step tool execution

* conversational systems

* browser automation

* voice systems

* approvals

* background tasks

* session management

* agent UX

* API integrations

* tool calling

* real-time applications



You should understand how to turn an AI agent into a reliable product, not just a chatbot.



---



5. INTEGRATIONS & CHANNELS ENGINEER

   Salary: USD $1,100/month



You will own external application connectivity.



Strong experience with:



* OAuth 2.0

* APIs

* webhooks

* Gmail / Google APIs

* Microsoft Graph

* calendars

*
 systems

* messaging APIs

* voice APIs

* real-time events

* authentication

* token refresh

* retries

* integration reliability



Experience with Composio or similar integration platforms is useful.



Experience with n8n, Zapier or Make is acceptable for THIS ROLE, but you must also understand direct API integration and production backend development.



---



6. BACKEND / DATA SYSTEMS ENGINEER

   Salary: USD $1,200/month



You will own core backend services and data consistency.



Strong experience required in:



* TypeScript / Node.js

* APIs

* SQL

* data modeling

* multi-tenant systems

* queues

* concurrency

* idempotency

* state management

* event-driven architecture

* security

* performance

* performance

8. LEAD PRODUCT DESIGN ENGINEER

This is NOT a marketing website designer position.



We need someone experienced in complex SaaS/product interfaces.



Strong skills expected in:



* product UX

* visual hierarchy

* typography

* spacing

* design systems

* responsive design

* mobile UX

* interaction design

* motion

* complex application interfaces

* component systems



React / TypeScript / Tailwind experience is strongly preferred.

A strong portfolio is mandatory.



---



9. FRONTEND PRODUCT ENGINEER

   Salary: USD $1,000/month



You will implement Tanero's product interface under the shared design system.



Strong experience required in:



* React

* TypeScript

* modern frontend architecture

* reusable components

* responsive interfaces

* accessibility

* complex SaaS applications

* performance

* state handling

* frontend testing



We are not looking for someone who primarily builds landing pages.



---



10. QA / RELIABILITY / AI EVALUATION ENGINEER

    Salary: USD $1,000/month



You will be responsible for proving that Tanero works correctly before changes reach production.



Strong experience desired in:



* automated testing

* Playwright

* end-to-end testing

* integration testing

* regression testing

* API testing

* failure injection

* edge-case discovery

* CI quality gates

* production debugging

* AI/LLM evaluations

* agent testing



You must enjoy finding ways software can fail.



This role is extremely important to us.



---



WHO WE DO NOT WANT



Please do not apply if:



* You are an agency.

* You are representing another developer.

* You want project-based freelance work only.

* You are applying to every software job without reading the description.

* Your primary technical experience is only Zapier, Make, n8n, GoHighLevel or basic workflow automation and you are applying for an AI engineering role.

* Your AI experience consists mainly of calling an LLM API and displaying the response.

* You cannot show evidence of previous work.

* You expect detailed instructions for every small task.

* You cannot independently investigate and solve technical problems.

* You are applying for a position not listed above.



WE WILL NOT REVIEW APPLICATIONS OUTSIDE THESE 10 POSITIONS.



---



HOW WE WORK



Tanero expects engineers to use AI development tools aggressively and responsibly.



Each engineer will receive professional AI development tools such as Claude Code and Codex.



The expected workflow is:



Understand the problem

→ investigate the existing system

→ design the correct solution

→ use AI to accelerate implementation

→ personally review the output

→ test aggressively

→ verify the result

→ take responsibility for production quality



We value results, engineering judgment, reliability and speed.



A small task should not become a one-week project without a legitimate technical reason.



At the same time, we do not expect employees to sacrifice their health or work unreasonable hours.



We expect approximately 8 focused working hours per day, 40 hours per week.



If you become blocked, communicate early.



Do not spend several days silently stuck on a problem.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Your FIRST LINE must contain:



ROLE: [exact position name from the list above]



Then provide:



1. Your requested monthly salary in USD.

2. Your current location.

3. Confirmation that you can work full-time, 40 hours/week.

4. GitHub profile, if available.

5. Portfolio or personal website, if relevant.

6. LinkedIn profile, if available.

7. Two or three projects most relevant to the role.

8. For each project, explain exactly what YOU personally designed or built.

9. Your primary programming languages and technologies.

10. A short answer to:



“What is the most technically difficult system you personally built, what went wrong while building it, and how did you make it reliable?”



AI/Agent candidates must also answer:



“Describe the most complex production AI agent system you have built. Explain its tool execution, state management, background work, retries, failure recovery, and how unsafe or duplicate actions were prevented.”



Do not send a generic ChatGPT-generated cover letter.



We care far more about what you have actually built and how you think.



---



IMPORTANT



Hiring is expected to begin approximately 3 months from now.



This posting is currently being used to identify and evaluate the strongest candidates in advance.



We are willing to wait for exceptional people.



We would rather hire 10 excellent engineers than 30 average engineers.



If selected for the next stage, candidates will later receive a short paid practical evaluation relevant to the exact position they applied for.

title: Technical Engineering Coordinator
description:
One seat. Technical judgment. Full accountability.



This is not a “hold the calendar and smile” support role.



We’re looking for a Technical Engineering Coordinator who can move comfortably between engineering calculations, technical correspondence, project coordination, and executive-level administrative support.



You should be able to look at a structural or mechanical calculation sheet, understand what you’re looking at, identify potential discrepancies, communicate clearly with a client, and keep the project moving — without everything being divided across three different people.



If you’re an engineer who is organized, commercially minded, technically sharp, and comfortable owning a moving workload, this could be a very strong fit.



What You’ll Do



* Own the inbox, don’t babysit it. Monitor and triage incoming
s based on urgency and complexity. Handle routine matters independently, route appropriately when needed, and respond directly to technical inquiries when you have the knowledge and judgment to do so.

* Review and validate engineering calculations. Check calculations for accuracy, consistency, and potential discrepancies before they become project or client issues.

* Keep engineering projects moving. Track timelines, deliverables, dependencies, follow-ups, and outstanding items across multiple active projects.

* Review and mark up technical documents. Use Bluebeam or equivalent redlining/markup software to review plan sets, submittals, drawings, and technical documentation.

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support. Handle scheduling, correspondence, coordination, documentation, follow-ups, and the many operational details that keep an engineering practice running smoothly.

* Communicate with clients professionally. Draft clear, concise, technically appropriate responses where required and ensure communication does not get lost in translation.

* Use technology intelligently. Leverage Microsoft Office and AI tools to improve drafting, research, documentation, organization, and workflow efficiency.

* Take ownership. Identify what needs to happen next and make it happen rather than waiting for someone to assign every step.



Non-Negotiable Requirements



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering**

* 5+ years of executive assistant, administrative, coordination, or comparable professional experience**, ideally supporting engineering or technical leadership

* Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage timelines, deliverables, priorities, and follow-ups

* Strong Microsoft Office proficiency, particularly Excel

* Familiarity with Bluebeam or comparable document markup/redlining software

* Strong spoken and written English

* Ability to understand and communicate technical information clearly

* Comfortable using AI tools for drafting, research, organization, and document-related tasks

* Strong technology skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

* Excellent judgment, organization, attention to detail, and follow-through



We’ll Evaluate You On



Relevant Work Experience



Your previous roles, scope of responsibilities, engineering/technical exposure, project coordination experience, and ability to operate at a high level.



Software & Technical Proficiency



Your working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel, Bluebeam or equivalent markup tools, project management platforms, communication tools, and AI-enabled productivity tools.



Remote Work Experience & Adaptability



Your ability to stay productive, organized, responsive, and accountable without someone physically supervising your work.



English Proficiency — Spoken & Written



You must be able to communicate confidently and professionally with US-based clients and engineering professionals.



Professionalism & Attitude



We value ownership, maturity, good judgment, respect, and a solution-oriented mindset. We’re looking for someone who brings solutions, not just problems.



Response Time & Clarity



In engineering, delays and vague communication can become expensive very quickly. You should be responsive, concise, and clear — especially when something requires immediate attention.



Internet & Work Setup



You must have a reliable internet connection, dependable computer/workstation, and professional remote-work environment suitable for full-time client-facing work.



Commitment to Role & Availability



This is a role that requires consistent attention and accountability. We’re looking for someone who can commit to the position and maintain reliable availability during agreed working hours.



Time Management & Dependability



You should be capable of managing competing priorities, meeting deadlines, following through on commitments, and keeping stakeholders informed without constant reminders.



Problem-Solving Skills



We want someone who can assess a situation, investigate, make reasonable decisions, and move things forward — not someone who stops at “there’s a problem.”



Willingness to Learn & Adapt



Engineering workflows, software, and client requirements evolve. You should be comfortable learning new tools and processes quickly and applying what you learn.



Hubstaff & Remote Accountability



This is a remote position, and Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work accountability.



You should be comfortable using Hubstaff appropriately and maintaining accurate work activity during scheduled hours. Remote work requires trust — and trust works both ways when expectations and accountability are clear.



Nice to Have



* Previous experience in an engineering firm, consultancy, construction company, or other technical environment

* Experience supporting engineering leadership or technical executives

* Exposure to construction documentation, plan review, submittals, or project workflows

* Formal project management certification

* Experience communicating directly with US-based clients

* Strong familiarity with Bluebeam

* A healthy sense of humor for those moments when the “urgent”
 turns out to be a font complaint



Why This Role Matters



You won’t be sitting on the sidelines waiting for instructions.



You’ll be part of the workflow that connects engineering, clients, documentation, administration, and project execution.

title: Amazon Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company: Black Voyage (US e-commerce brand)

Location: Remote

Pay: 3-5USD [ / hour (based on experience) + raises for high performers



Quick Highlights

Own and elevate our entire customer support operation — not just answer tickets

Weekly sync 1–2x/week (10:00–11:00 AM Manila time) — no daily night shifts

You'll build and refine the SOPs, templates, and dashboards the team runs on

Direct line to leadership — your calls on tone, escalations, and process will shape the brand's customer experience

About Black Voyage



Black Voyage is a fast-growing US e-commerce brand specializing in premium vacuum compression travel gear. In our first year, we achieved multi-million USD revenue across Amazon and Shopify. Our customers are frequent travelers who care deeply about design, efficiency, and smart packing.



We're a small, fast-moving team that values: clarity, ownership, empathy, and high-quality communication.



Schedule



Flexible hours, with availability for a weekly team sync (1–2x/week) during Manila/Taiwan time 10:00–11:00 AM. In most weeks, you'll receive written priorities after the sync; live attendance may not always be required.



Role Overview



We're hiring a Customer Support Specialist to own the customer experience function end-to-end — not just handling tickets, but building the systems, standards, and (eventually) team that keep our support operation sharp as we scale.



This is not a "follow the script" job. We want someone who can set the standard, catch problems before they escalate, and make judgment calls when situations fall outside SOPs.



Focus Split (Typical)



Customer Support Oversight & Escalation Ownership: ~40–50%

Process, SOPs & Quality Management: ~25–30%

Reporting, Metrics & Dashboards: ~15–20%

Cross-functional Coordination (Ops/Influencer support as needed): ~10%

What You'll Do



1) Customer Support Oversight



Own the customer support inbox/queue end-to-end — response quality, tone, and turnaround time

Personally handle or review the most sensitive, high-risk cases (chargeback threats, angry customers, PR-sensitive situations)

Set and enforce response-time and resolution-quality standards



2) Risk & Escalation Management



Own the escalation process for disputes, chargebacks, and 1-star review threats

Make judgment calls on refund/compensation decisions within approved guidelines, and flag exceptions to the CEO

Identify recurring issues (product, shipping, policy) and proactively raise them before they become bigger problems



3) Process, SOPs & Quality



Build, document, and continuously improve customer support SOPs, macros, and templates

Spot-check ticket quality and provide coaching/feedback as the team grows

Maintain a clean, well-organized knowledge base so answers stay consistent



4) Reporting & Metrics



Track and report on key support metrics (response time, resolution time, CSAT, chargeback rate)

Maintain dashboards and trackers (Google Sheets / Notion) that give leadership a clear view of support health

Surface trends and recommendations based on the data, not just raw numbers



5) Cross-functional Support (as needed)



Coordinate with Operations on order/shipping-related support issues

Support light influencer/creator communication using existing templates and guidelines when needed

Who You Are

Excellent written English (you can switch tone: warm & professional for customers; clear & direct with the team/leadership)

Proven experience owning or managing a customer support function, ideally in e-commerce/DTC

Detail-oriented and structured — comfortable managing volume without dropping threads or letting quality slip

Emotionally intelligent — you can de-escalate, stay calm under pressure, and choose the right level of firmness

A builder, not just an operator — you improve the system, not just execute it

Resourceful problem-solver (you try to find the answer first, then ask smart questions when needed)

Tech-comfortable (Shopify +Amazon + Google Workspace is a plus, but not required)

How to Apply (Single-Step — Please Follow Exactly)



We're looking for candidates with strong attention to detail. Applications that don't follow instructions may be ignored.



 to 
 

with the subject line:

Customer Support Team Assistant



In your
, include ALL 3 items below:



1) Resume

Attach as PDF or share a link.



2) 1–2 Minute Loom Video

Briefly introduce yourself and answer:

"Tell us about a time you had to build or improve a process (not just follow one) at work. What did you do, and what was the result?"



3) Written Exercise (Copy & Paste Answers into the
)



Task A (Customer Support – Chargeback Prevention)

A customer is furious. They
:

"I never received my package! You guys stole my money. Refund me immediately or I'm calling my bank!"

You check tracking and it shows Delivered, with a clear Proof of Delivery (POD) photo showing the package at their front door.

Write your reply.

Goal: De-escalate their anger, show empathy, reduce chargeback risk, provide the POD info, and guide next steps.



Task B (Process/Quality Judgment Call)

You notice that 3 different customers this week have complained about the same issue (e.g., a packaging defect) but each was handled differently by past responses — one got a full refund, one got a partial refund, one got only an apology.

What would you do? Write a short plan (a few sentences) covering: (1) how you'd handle the current cases fairly, and (2) what you'd put in place going forward to prevent inconsistent handling.



Technical Requirements (Must Have)

Reliable internet (minimum 20 Mbps)

Backup internet option (mobile hotspot is fine)

Laptop/PC capable of multitasking

Interview Process



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a single interview. No second-round assignments.

title: Direct Response Video Ads Editor

- Familiarity with AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas.

- Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a team.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

- A Professional Accountancy & Advisory Firm with offices in Sydney, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. 



- Strawberry Farms in Victoria and Queensland, Australia. 



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our growing marketing team. The ideal candidate will support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing activities across our businesses. 



This is a hands-on and varied role covering social media, content marketing,
 marketing, lead generation, paid advertising, website marketing, and campaign reporting. 



You will work closely with the Marketing Manager and internal teams to help turn marketing strategies into well-executed campaigns that build brand awareness, generate leads, and support business growth. 



If you are interested in working with international brands across different industries, enjoy both creative and analytical work, and want to develop experience across the full digital marketing mix, we'd love to hear from you. 



Role & Responsibilities:



- The responsibilities of this role are varied and involve both creative and analytical tasks. While experience in several areas is preferred, we are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and eager to develop their skills. 



Key responsibilities include: 



- Support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing campaigns across multiple brands and industries. 



- Manage and grow digital marketing activities across relevant channels, including social media,
, websites, search, and paid advertising. 



- Plan, create, schedule, and coordinate marketing content using content calendars. 



- Assist in developing and implementing digital marketing strategies aligned with each brand's business goals. 



- Create and coordinate social media, website, blog,
, and campaign content.

 campaigns, promotional content, landing page copy, and advertisements. 



- Support lead generation activities through digital campaigns, social media,
 marketing, and other relevant channels. 



- Assist with the creation, scheduling, and optimization of
 marketing campaigns and customer communications.

- Monitor website traffic, campaign activity, audience engagement, leads, and conversions. 



- Track and report on key marketing performance metrics, including website traffic, engagement, leads, conversions,
 performance, and advertising results.

- Conduct market, competitor, audience, and keyword research to identify marketing opportunities. 



- Support SEO and website content optimization initiatives. 



- Assist with landing pages and other digital assets to improve lead generation and conversion. 



- Test and optimize marketing content, messaging, audiences, creatives, and campaigns based on performance data. 



- Actively stay up to date with digital marketing trends, platform updates, SEO, advertising strategies, and emerging marketing tools. 



- Collaborate with the Marketing Manager, designers, content creators, and other internal teams to ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with brand messaging. 



- Manage multiple campaigns, projects, content schedules, and priorities across the group's different businesses. 



Preferred Skills:



- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. 



- Strong interest and understanding of digital marketing and the customer journey. 



- Experience with social media marketing and content management. 



- Basic understanding of paid advertising platforms, particularly Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. 



- Familiarity with
 marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or similar tools. 



- Basic understanding of SEO, keyword research, and website optimization. 



- Strong copywriting skills with the ability to create engaging and conversion-focused content. 



- Analytical mindset with attention to marketing and campaign performance metrics. 



- Organized and able to manage multiple campaigns, brands, and deadlines. 



- A proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and willingness to learn. 



- Ability to balance creative thinking with data-driven decision-making. 



Requirements:



- 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, social media, content marketing, lead generation, paid advertising, or a related role. 



- Experience supporting or managing digital marketing campaigns across one or more channels. 



- Experience managing social media platforms such as
, Instagram, LinkedIn, or similar channels. 



- Experience creating digital marketing content, including social media posts,
 campaigns, promotional copy, or website content. 



- Basic to intermediate understanding of paid advertising, including audience targeting, ad creatives, campaign setup, and optimization. 



- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics,
 marketing platforms, or similar marketing tools. 



- Basic understanding of SEO principles, keyword research, and content optimization. 



- Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement. 



- Ability to interpret key digital marketing metrics such as engagement, reach, CTR, conversion rate, leads, and campaign performance.

- Experience using Canva, WordPress, Shopify, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools is a plus. 



- Experience working in a remote or distributed team environment is an advantage.

What We're Looking For:



- We are looking for a hands-on, well-rounded, and commercially minded digital marketer who enjoys turning ideas and strategies into action. 



- The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different areas of digital marketing and can balance creativity with performance. You should be curious about what drives results and willing to continuously test, learn, and improve.

title: Video Editor (E-commerce)
description:
Basic Headline Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $5 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new product lines launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely across the world.

This role is a starting point, and we're straight about that — it's focused work editing headline videos to a proven format. But it's a starting point on a team that promotes from the inside. Many of our editors have been with us two or more years, and the ones who started here are now the people briefing everyone else.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

AI Advanced Editor.

That's the next title, and it's the step most of our strong headline editors make inside their first six months. An AI Advanced Editor works on our highest-leverage creative: AI-assisted video, hook development, and the ad formats we scale behind. You stop working purely to a template and start building the ones other people follow.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning creative — when a video you cut hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within three to six months, you're consistently producing headline videos that perform on both paid and organic channels — 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates — and iterating on winning formats without needing day-to-day direction.

Responsibilities

Edit TikTok and Reels headline content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Review past edits daily, identify what is and isn't working, and apply those lessons

Work with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on proven formats

Turn work around quickly and communicate proactively each day

Track TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where relevant

Requirements

A recent portfolio of short-form edits (ideally 20+ from the past few months)

Ability to break down why a viral video or high-performing ad worked

Comfortable reading performance metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time) and adjusting accordingly

Skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to work independently

Takes ownership and applies feedback consistently

Preferred

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Exposure to AI video tools, talking heads, or voiceover formats

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing roles teach you software. This one teaches you why things sell. You'll get direct access to paid ad data on real spend, see which of your creatives print money and which die, and build the one skill that makes editors expensive: knowing what to make before you make it.

Access to courses and paid software

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Full visibility into TikTok and Meta performance data on your own work

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You prefer a fixed schedule or close day-to-day supervision

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD

100% remote, approximately 40 hours per week, long-term

Flexible schedule with no required timezone overlap — async communication daily

Flexible paid time off, coordinated with the team

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), TikTok and Meta analytics

No micromanagement

How to Apply

Applications take about five minutes. We review every submission.

title: Part-Time Tax & Bookkeeping Operations Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and proactive professional to serve as the second set of eyes for our growing tax administration and bookkeeping business.



This is not a basic administrative position. We need someone with strong tax and bookkeeping knowledge who can oversee our administrative team, monitor client work, identify issues before they become problems, and ensure daily operations run smoothly.



Position Details



* Part-time: approximately 2–3 hours per day

* Monday through Friday

* Availability required during regular business hours, between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. [EST Time Zone]

* Long-term opportunity with potential for increased hours, responsibilities, and compensation as the business grows



Key Responsibilities



* Oversee and support the administrative team

* Assign, monitor, and follow up on team tasks

* Ensure client requests and deliverables are handled accurately and on time

* Review workflows, task lists, deadlines, and outstanding items

* Answer team questions and provide guidance on tax administration and bookkeeping matters

* Identify missing information, errors, delays, and potential client-service issues

* Communicate important updates, concerns, and recommendations to the business owner

* Help improve procedures, checklists, accountability systems, and internal processes

* Ensure the office continues running smoothly without requiring constant supervision from the owner

* Assist with light bookkeeping and tax-related administrative work when needed

* Maintain strict confidentiality when handling client and financial information



Qualifications



* Strong working knowledge of tax administration and bookkeeping & software (MUST KNOW - Taxdome, QBO/Xero, Proconnect, Gusto, Adp, Click ups, etc)

* Previous experience in a tax office, accounting firm, bookkeeping practice, or similar professional-services environment

* Supervisory, office-management, or team-lead experience

* Strong understanding of deadlines, client follow-up, document collection, and workflow management

* Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills

* Comfortable reviewing the work of others and holding team members accountable

* Able to work independently, take ownership, and follow through without constant direction

* Proficient with bookkeeping, tax, project-management, and office software
