title: AI Automation & Business Process Specialist
description:
# AI Automation & Business Process Specialist



**Australian Property Inspection Business | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity**



We’re an established Australian property inspection business looking for an experienced **AI Automation & Business Process Specialist** to work with us on a part-time basis, with the potential for an ongoing long-term role.



This is **not a general VA position**.



We’re looking for someone who can understand how a business operates, identify repetitive or inefficient processes, recommend better ways of doing things, and then actually build and implement the automations.



We don’t want someone who simply waits for instructions.



We want someone who can eventually say:



> “I’ve watched how your team handles this process. You’re spending several hours each week doing something manually that could be automated. Here’s what I recommend.”



## What You’ll Be Doing



Your first job will be to understand how our business currently operates.



This may include:



* Sitting in on Teams or Zoom meetings

* Watching staff perform their normal tasks

* Reviewing screen recordings

* Speaking with our admin and sales team

* Reviewing existing workflows and systems

* Mapping how information currently moves through the business



We then want you to identify:



* Manual tasks that could be automated

* Duplicate work

* Bottlenecks

* Unnecessary administration

* Follow-ups that are being missed

* Opportunities to use AI

* Ways to improve customer response times

* Ways to improve our sales process

* Ways to reduce the owner’s involvement in routine admin



After identifying the opportunities, we want you to help **design, build, test and maintain the solutions**.



## Systems We Currently Use



Our systems include:



* Microsoft 365

* Outlook

* OneDrive

* SharePoint

* Excel

* Microsoft Power Automate

* Microsoft Copilot

* HubSpot

* ServiceM8

* Xero

* 3CX

* Google Ads / Google leads

* Social media platforms



Experience with **APIs, webhooks, Make and Zapier** is also highly valuable.



You don’t need to have experience with every system listed above, but you must be technically strong enough to learn new systems and integrate them properly.



# Projects We Want to Work On



## 1. AI
 & Outlook Automation



We want to improve how we manage a busy Outlook inbox.



We’d like AI and automation to help:



* Identify important
s

* Identify
s requiring a response

* Prioritise urgent
s

* Separate low-priority
s

* Draft replies

* Flag
s requiring management attention

* Remind us when important
s haven’t been answered

* Delegate appropriate
s to staff

* Summarise long
 conversations

* Reduce unnecessary inbox clutter

* Produce a daily summary of
s requiring action



Where appropriate, AI should also be able to use information stored in **OneDrive and SharePoint** when preparing responses.



## 2. Lead Automation



When Google or website leads arrive, we want the process to become much more automated.



For example:



**New enquiry received → capture client information → add/update CRM → send personalised acknowledgement → assign follow-up → notify staff → escalate if nobody responds → continue follow-up where appropriate.**



The aim is to:



* Respond to new leads quickly

* Stop leads being forgotten

* Reduce manual data entry

* Improve conversion rates

* Give management visibility over leads that haven’t been followed up



## 3. ServiceM8 & Operations Automation



We want you to review our ServiceM8 processes and identify opportunities to automate areas such as:



* Job creation

* Booking readiness

* Scheduling

* Inspector allocation

* Client communication

* Inspection reminders

* Missing information

* Job-status monitoring

* Report follow-up

* Completed-job checks

* Internal notifications

* Daily operational checks



We expect you to identify opportunities we may not have thought of ourselves.



## 4. Accounts & Payment Follow-Up



We want to improve automation between Xero, Outlook and our other systems.



Potential projects include:



* Outstanding invoice reminders

* Automatic payment follow-up

* Internal alerts for overdue accounts

* Identifying accounts requiring human attention

* Daily or weekly outstanding-account summaries

* Reducing manual payment chasing

* Escalating accounts that require management involvement



## 5. HubSpot & Business Development Automation



We have a Business Development Manager who contacts real estate agents and potential referral partners.



Our prospective clients are managed through HubSpot.



We want AI and automation to help our BDM become much more productive.



Potential projects include:



* Prioritising the best prospects to contact

* Identifying warm opportunities

* Creating daily or weekly call lists

* AI-assisted prospect research

* Preparing call notes

* Personalised outreach
s

* Automatic follow-up sequences

* Follow-up reminders

* Drafting
s after calls

* Tracking conversations

* Re-engaging old prospects

* Identifying referral partners who have gone quiet

* Sales-pipeline reporting

* Showing management which opportunities need attention



We don’t want generic spam or mass AI-generated messages.



We want **targeted and personalised outreach that helps our BDM spend more time building relationships and less time doing administration.**



## 6. AI-Assisted Marketing & Social Media



We also want to explore AI-assisted marketing, including:



* Social-media content ideas

* Drafting LinkedIn,
 and Instagram posts

* Repurposing inspection information into useful content

* Educational content for real estate agents and property buyers

* Scheduling approved content

* Creating an approval process before publishing

* Helping our business stay visible to referral partners



Content needs to sound natural and useful, not like generic AI advertising.



## 7. Owner’s Daily Dashboard / Morning Brief



One of our biggest goals is to reduce the amount of time the business owner spends checking different systems.



We’d like to eventually receive one simple daily summary showing:



* Important
s requiring a response

* New leads

* Leads not followed up

* Today’s inspections

* Jobs with problems

* Outstanding reports

* Overdue invoices

* Important client issues

* Sales opportunities requiring attention

* Tasks requiring management decisions



Instead of checking multiple systems, we want the important information brought together automatically.



# What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone with **real hands-on automation experience**.



Ideally, you have strong experience with:



* Microsoft Power Automate

* Microsoft 365

* Microsoft Copilot

* Outlook automation

* SharePoint

* OneDrive

* AI agents

* HubSpot automation

* APIs

* Webhooks

* Make and/or Zapier

* CRM automation

* Business-process mapping

* AI workflow development



Experience with **ServiceM8, Xero or 3CX** would be a strong advantage.



More important than knowing every system is being able to understand a business problem, design the right solution and build it properly.



# How We Want to Start



We don’t want someone to immediately start building dozens of automations.



The first stage will be:



1. Learn how our business operates

2. Observe our team and current processes

3. Map our main workflows

4. Identify bottlenecks and repetitive work

5. Recommend and prioritise automation opportunities

6. Estimate the effort, cost and expected benefit

7. Start implementing the highest-value projects



Our goal is to substantially reduce unnecessary administration, improve response times and gradually remove the business owner from routine checking and follow-up.



There is potential for this to become an ongoing role as we continue improving and automating the business.



# IMPORTANT – Please Read Before Applying



This position requires **real practical experience**.



Please don’t apply if your experience is limited to watching tutorials, completing courses or building very basic Zapier workflows.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to:



* Show examples of real automations you’ve personally built

* Screen-share and explain how an automation works

* Explain the trigger, logic, integrations and error handling

* Provide previous client or employer references

* Complete a small **paid practical automation test using dummy data**



You will **not** be given access to our live customer information or sensitive systems during the test.



We’re happy to consider someone who hasn’t worked with every system listed in this advertisement if you have strong automation skills and can demonstrate that you learn new systems quickly.



# How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with AI automation and business-process improvement

3. Your Microsoft Power Automate experience

4. Examples of automations you’ve personally built

5. Your HubSpot experience

6. Your experience integrating software using APIs or webhooks

7. Whether you’ve worked with ServiceM8, Xero, 3CX or similar systems

8. Your hourly rate in USD

9. Your weekly availability

10. A short Loom or video introduction if possible



Please also answer this question:



**“If you joined a business where the owner knows there is too much manual administration but doesn’t know exactly what should be automated, how would you spend your first two weeks?”**



Please don’t send a generic application.



We’re much more interested in **what you have actually built, how you think, and how you approach improving a real business process**.

description:
AUTOMOTIVE OPERATIONS & DISPATCH COORDINATOR

-We’re hiring a high-performing, detail-obsessed Operations Coordinator to help us run and grow a mobile automotive shop in Austin, Texas — a premium mobile tire and oil change business serving performance car owners and select fleets in the Austin metro area.

-This is a hybrid customer-facing and backend operations role. You’ll be responsible for making sure the daily work gets done accurately, efficiently, and on time — coordinating jobs, processing approvals, managing tech schedules, tracking AR, and keeping our customers in the loop.

-You’ll also assist with light marketing coordination (e.g., newsletter support, gathering photos from the team) — just a few hours weekly.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Fleet & Retail Ops Coordination

-Own the estimate-to-approval-to-route workflow:

-Create and submit estimates

-Follow up for approval

-Ensure parts are sourced

-Finalize tech routes for the following day

-Track all jobs in progress and flag issues proactively

-Ensure routes are realistic and efficient; confirm techs are prepped and ready

-Communicate clearly with customers and fleet managers about job timing, status, and follow-ups

-Submit and close out fleet approvals in Element, LeasePlan, and AutoIntegrate

-Ensure invoices match approvals; follow up on outstanding invoices and missing payments



2. Scheduling & Productivity Tracking

-Maintain the daily technician schedule, making updates as needed

-Monitor tech productivity; flag idle time, reschedules, or delays

-Track time logs and coordinate with bookkeeper for payroll



3. Customer Communication

-Respond to incoming texts, WhatsApp messages, and system inquiries in a timely, professional manner

-Follow up with clients as needed to resolve open issues or gather job-related info

-Escalate concerns appropriately and promptly



4. Admin & Reporting

-Submit a detailed Daily Recap covering completed work, pending tasks, blockers, and KPIs

-Keep Trello and other tools up-to-date with accurate job and task statuses

-Track inventory needs and coordinate ordering of parts, oil, and supplies

-Monitor A/R and follow up on past-due fleet invoices



5. Marketing & Content Support

-Publish our monthly newsletter in MailChimp with content from marketing team

-Coordinate publishing of content to Instagram /
 / Google My Business

-Other light admin support as needed for the marketing team

-What Success Looks Like

-All work orders, estimates, approvals, and tech routes are handled with zero dropped balls

-You identify blockers or problems before they become fires

-Communication is clear, timely, and professional — with both customers and internal team

-The business runs like a machine — nothing gets missed or delayed

-You take full ownership of your responsibilities and require very little follow-up



Who You Are

-A natural systems thinker who thrives on clarity, organization, and ownership

-Extremely proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do

-Excellent at written and verbal English communication

-Comfortable in the automotive world and eager to learn the details

-Sharp and reliable — you retain info, spot gaps, and follow through



Experience & Skills Required

-3+ years of experience in a remote automotive: coordinator, dispatcher, operations role

-Demonstrated responsibility for keeping things moving without handholding

-Excellent written and spoken English

-Experience with dispatch, route planning, or technician scheduling

-Familiar with tools like Slack, Google Docs, Trello (or similar), CRM/invoicing platforms

-Experience working with U.S.-based field service, auto, or fleet companies

-Bonus: Familiarity with AutoIntegrate, Housecall Pro, Element, or LeasePlan platforms



Required Software Experience

-Slack

-WhatsApp

-Trello (or similar)

-Google Workspace

-CRM / invoicing tools (Housecall Pro, AutoIntegrate)


 (plus)



TECH REQUIREMENTS:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

-Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed

-Dual monitor setup is required to ensure efficiency in managing multiple applications simultaneously.



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Part-time, US hours



Schedule

-Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM–7:00 PM CST

-Saturday: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM CST

-Sunday: 12:00 PM–4:00 PM CST

Note: Flexibility is required, as the shift schedule may change. The schedule consists of 7 shifts across 2 weeks.



Pay: ₱288.46 - ₱432.69 hourly rate

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren

title: Entry-Level AI Graphic Designer
description:
AI Graphic Designer

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $3 to $6 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.

You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine, and you'll help build that side of the creative machine.

That's the opportunity: you're not joining a mature department to take instructions. You're building the static side of a content operation that has already proved it can do a quarter billion views.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Designer.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. A Senior Designer here owns the visual direction of our image ads: you test your own concepts rather than executing briefs, you expand our prompt library, and you set the standard the rest of the team designs to.

It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.

What You'll Earn

Base: $3 to $6 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning ad. When a creative you made hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it.

There's no cap on how good your month can be

What Success Looks Like

Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process, creating work that passes review without rework and matches the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.

Core Responsibilities

Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output

Must-Haves

Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative

What You'll Learn Here

AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.

Direct access to ad performance data on your own creatives, so you learn what converts, not just what looks good

Our internal prompt library and workflows, plus the paid AI tools to run them

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software

A portfolio of creatives with performance numbers attached, which is the thing that gets designers hired at the next level

Not a Fit If

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

You want to make art rather than ads that perform

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you deliver and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools you'll use: Photoshop, AI image generation tools (Higgsfield or similar), our internal prompt library

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Faceless Brand Social Media & Growth Manager
description:
We are hiring a resourceful, data-driven Social Media & Growth Manager to fully operate and grow a faceless social media brand.



This is not simply a “post three times per day” position. Your job is to manage the entire audience-growth system:



**Content → Followers → Website Visitors →
 Leads → Community Members → Customers**



You will research content, create or coordinate production, publish daily, engage with the audience, analyze performance and help convert social media attention into an audience we own through our website and funnel.



## The Goal



Your primary goal is to build a large, engaged audience around the brand and move qualified followers from social platforms into our owned ecosystem.



You will be responsible for improving:



* Reach and video views

* Followers and follower-conversion rate

* Shares, saves, comments and watch time

* Profile visits

* Website clicks

*
 subscribers

* Community members

* Leads and sales generated through the funnel



We are looking for someone who wants ownership of measurable results—not someone who only wants to complete a checklist.



## Platforms You May Manage



Depending on the brand, you may manage:



* Instagram

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts

*

* Pinterest

*
 or another private community

* The brand’s website, landing pages and
 funnel



Content will normally be created once and adapted properly for each platform.



## Core Responsibilities



### 1. Develop and Manage the Content Strategy



You will:



* Research the target audience, competitors, trends and content gaps.

* Identify the audience’s problems, desires, questions and buying motivations.

* Develop recurring content series that make the brand recognizable.

* Build a 30-, 60- and 90-day content calendar.

* Plan content around growth, trust, lead generation and monetization.

* Maintain a balanced mix of educational, entertaining, emotional, relatable and promotional content.

* Create content that can grow beyond a small niche and support a brand with one million or more followers.

* Recommend new formats, offers and funnel improvements based on audience behavior.



### 2. Research and Source Content



You must be able to consistently find strong content ideas without waiting for the owner to tell you what to post.



You will:



* Monitor relevant creators, communities, publications and trending conversations.

* Research high-performing topics, hooks, formats and audience questions.

* Study comments and reviews to identify pain points and content ideas.

* Maintain a content idea bank with sources, angles, hooks and recommended CTAs.

* Find usable stock footage, public-domain material, brand-owned assets and properly licensed media.

* Request written permission before reposting creator-owned material when required.

* Maintain a source and permission log.

* Avoid stolen, watermarked, low-resolution or legally questionable content.

* Verify factual claims through credible primary sources.



### 3. Create High-Quality Faceless Content



You will create or manage the production of:



* Short-form videos

* Reels

* TikToks

* YouTube Shorts

* Carousels

* Static posts

* Stories

* Polls and engagement posts

* Lead-generation content

* Promotional content



Each short-form video should include:



1. A strong first-frame hook

2. Immediate context

3. A valuable, entertaining or emotional payoff

4. Clear on-screen captions

5. Clean pacing and professional audio

6. A relevant cover headline

7. One specific call to action



You should be comfortable using tools such as:



* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro or similar software

* Google Drive

* ChatGPT or other approved AI tools

* Meta Business Suite

* Native platform scheduling tools

* Project-management software



AI may help accelerate research and production, but content must still feel intentional, accurate and human.



### 4. Publish and Optimize Daily



You will:



* Publish consistently according to the approved schedule.

* Prepare platform-specific captions, covers, titles, keywords and hashtags.

* Adapt each post to the platform instead of uploading identical, watermarked files everywhere.

* Select appropriate audio without creating copyright problems.

* Tag sources, contributors and collaborators correctly.

* Review every post for spelling, factual accuracy, visual quality and brand consistency.

* Monitor scheduled posts to confirm they publish successfully.

* Update the content calendar with live post URLs.

* Keep a minimum seven-day buffer of approved content.



The expected starting production goal may be up to:



* Three high-quality short-form videos per day

* Daily Stories

* Several supporting carousels or static posts per week

* Weekly lead-generation and funnel content



Quality must remain high. Posting volume is not an excuse for weak hooks, stolen content or careless editing.



### 5. Manage Community Engagement



You will:



* Respond to relevant comments and direct messages in the approved brand voice.

* Engage with early comments immediately after publishing.

* Ask intelligent follow-up questions that encourage conversation.

* Pin useful or engaging comments.

* Welcome new community members.

* Identify frequently asked questions that can become future content.

* Build relationships with creators and potential collaborators.

* Leave meaningful comments on relevant accounts.

* Remove spam and moderate harmful comments.

* Escalate legal threats, ownership complaints, sensitive issues or serious customer concerns.



You must never argue emotionally, insult followers or create unnecessary controversy.



### 6. Build the Owned-Audience Funnel



Social media followers are valuable, but the business must also build an audience it owns.



You will help move followers through this path:



**Social content → Profile → Website → Landing page →
 opt-in → Community → Offer**



Your responsibilities include:



* Making sure the profile clearly communicates who the page serves and why people should follow.

* Maintaining the bio link and ensuring it leads to the correct page.

* Creating content that naturally sends qualified viewers to the website.

* Testing lead magnets, headlines, calls to action and landing-page positioning.

* Confirming forms,
s, buttons and thank-you pages work correctly.

* Coordinating with developers when a technical change is required.

* Tracking website clicks, opt-ins and funnel conversion rates.

* Helping organize
 subscribers and community members by source.

* Recommending improvements when social traffic is not converting.



You do not need to be an advanced web developer, but you must understand funnels and be able to identify when something is broken or underperforming.



### 7. Create Promise-Specific Calls to Action



Do not place several unrelated CTAs in one post.



Each post should have one primary action connected to the value promised in the content.



Examples:



* “Follow this page for daily strategies that help you accomplish [specific result].”

* “Save this so you can use the steps when you are ready.”

* “Send this to someone struggling with [specific problem].”

* “Get the free [lead magnet] through the link in our bio.”

* “Join our
 list so you do not miss the next update.”

* “Visit the website for the complete guide.”



You will track which CTA language creates the most followers, website clicks and
 opt-ins.



### 8. Track Performance and Improve the Strategy



Every post must be treated as a test.



You will track performance at approximately 24 hours and seven days, including:



* Views and reach

* Average watch time

* Retention or completion rate

* Shares

* Saves

* Comments

* Profile visits

* New followers

* Follows per 1,000 views

* Website clicks

*
 opt-ins

* Community joins

* Leads and sales, when trackable



You will identify:



* Winning topics

* Winning hooks

* Winning formats

* Strongest recurring series

* Best posting times

* Highest-converting CTAs

* Content that produces views but fails to produce followers

* Content that attracts followers but fails to generate leads



When a post wins, you should quickly create new variations using different hooks, examples, angles or audience segments. Do not simply repost the identical file.



### 9. Submit Weekly Reports



Every week, you will submit a clear report containing:



* Number of posts published

* Total views and reach

* Net follower growth

* Follows per 1,000 views

* Website clicks

*
 subscribers generated

* Community members generated

* Leads and sales attributed to social media

* Top five posts and why they performed

* Bottom five posts and why they underperformed

* Tests completed

* Lessons learned

* Next week’s content plan

* Problems requiring the owner’s decision

* Current number of approved posts in the content buffer



Reports should explain what the numbers mean and what should happen next.



## First 30-Day Priorities



During your first month, you will be expected to:



### Week 1: Audit and Setup



* Review the brand, audience, offer and existing accounts.

* Audit previous content and performance.

* Research at least 10 relevant competitors.

* Confirm the target customer and brand promise.

* Optimize the profile, biography, profile image and link.

* Review the website and funnel for broken links or confusing messaging.

* Create an organized content calendar and asset system.

* Establish baseline performance metrics.



### Week 2: Launch the Content System



* Establish recurring content series.

* Begin the approved publishing schedule.

* Create an approved library of hooks, CTAs and cover styles.

* Build at least a seven-day content buffer.

* Begin daily engagement and outreach.



### Week 3: Test and Improve



* Compare topics, hooks, lengths, CTAs and posting times.

* Identify early winners.

* Produce variations of winning content.

* Improve underperforming profile and funnel elements.



### Week 4: Report and Scale



* Present the first complete monthly report.

* Recommend what should be increased, reduced, changed or eliminated.

* Present the following month’s strategy and content calendar.

* Create a plan for increasing followers, website traffic and
 subscribers.



## Required Qualifications



You should apply if you:



* Have experience managing and growing social media accounts.

* Understand short-form video strategy and retention.

* Can edit professional vertical videos.

* Can create content without showing your face.

* Can write strong hooks, captions and calls to action.

* Understand the difference between views, followers, leads and customers.

* Understand basic website funnels and
 lead generation.

* Can interpret analytics and make decisions from the data.

* Are organized and can manage a high-volume content calendar.

* Can independently research topics and verify facts.

* Communicate clearly in written English.

* Can follow detailed SOPs while still thinking independently.

* Are reliable, proactive and comfortable being measured by results.

* Have dependable internet access and a computer capable of video editing.



## Preferred Qualifications



These are helpful but not mandatory:



* Experience growing a page from zero.

* Experience managing a faceless brand or theme page.

* Experience with Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

* Experience creating lead magnets or
 opt-in campaigns.

* Experience using website builders or funnel software.

* Experience with
 marketing platforms.

* Experience managing
, 
 or another private community.

* Experience coordinating creators, editors or other contractors.

* Basic understanding of conversion-rate optimization.

* Familiarity with UTM links, pixels and website analytics.



## Performance Standards



Your work will be evaluated based on:



* Consistency and reliability

* Content quality

* Hook and retention performance

* Follower growth

* Follows generated per 1,000 views

* Shares and saves

* Website traffic

*
 subscriber growth

* Community growth

* Funnel conversion

* Accuracy and brand safety

* Ability to find and repeat winning content

* Quality of reporting and recommendations



No ethical manager can guarantee viral growth or a specific number of followers. However, you will be expected to consistently test, measure, learn and improve the performance of the brand.



## What This Position Is Not



This position is not a fit if you:



* Need the owner to provide every content idea.

* Only know how to repost other people’s videos.

* Believe success means posting without reviewing analytics.

* Use fake followers, engagement bots or spam tactics.

* Ignore copyright, permissions or content ownership.

* Frequently miss deadlines.

* Disappear when you encounter a problem.

* Cannot explain why a post succeeded or failed.

* Are unwilling to be accountable for measurable outcomes.

* Performance review period: First 30 days

* Long-term opportunity available for a high-performing manager



Because social media operates seven days per week, scheduled publishing and community coverage must be planned in advance. The exact working schedule and weekend expectations will be discussed during the interview.



## How to Apply



Submit an application containing all of the following:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit.

2. Links to social media accounts you have personally managed.

3. Screenshots or reports showing measurable results.

4. Your exact responsibilities for each account.

5. A link to three short-form videos you personally created or managed.

6. Your experience with websites, funnels,
 lists or online communities.

7. The tools you use for research, editing, scheduling and reporting.

8. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

9. Your internet speed and computer specifications.

10. Your earliest available start date.



Please also answer these questions:



* If a Reel receives many views but almost no new followers, what would you investigate?

* How would you turn one successful Reel into five new pieces of content?

* How would you move followers from Instagram or TikTok onto an
 list?

* How do you legally and ethically source content for a faceless page?

* What metrics would you include in your weekly report?

* What would you do if you discovered that a scheduled website link was broken?

* What would your first seven days in this position look like?



Begin your application with the exact words:



**“I KNOW THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN ATTENTION AND OWNERSHIP.”**



Applications that do not begin with this sentence may not be reviewed.



## Final Interview



After submitting your complete application, schedule your Zoom interview here:







Only schedule an interview after submitting the requested information. Be prepared to discuss your previous work, explain your growth strategy and complete a short practical evaluation.



We are looking for someone who can become the trusted operator of an entire faceless brand—not simply another person who posts content.

title: Video Editor
description:
Freelance Video Editor — Role Scope & Job Description



Employer: AXIS Media Group

Type: Freelance / Contract, project-based

Hours: No fixed hours — work is assigned per project with a deadline, not a schedule

Rate: Starting at $25 AUD per project (scales with project complexity/length, negotiable as the working relationship develops)

Location: Remote



About the role



AXIS Media Group is a marketing agency producing content across multiple client accounts — social video, ad creatives, and campaign edits for businesses in trades, retail, hospitality, and automotive. We're looking for a freelance video editor to join our production pool: someone who can turn raw footage into polished, on-brand deliverables without needing hand-holding on the basics.



This is project-based freelance work, not a rostered role. You'll be assigned edits as they come in, with a brief and a deadline, and you manage your own time to hit it.



What you'll actually be doing



Editing raw footage from client shoots into finished social/marketing videos (reels, ad creatives, promo edits)

Working from a creative brief provided by the production team

Colour correction, audio cleanup, captions/subtitles, and basic motion graphics/text overlays

Cutting footage down to platform-specific formats (Instagram/TikTok vertical, YouTube/website horizontal)

Delivering drafts for internal review, then applying revision notes

Naming and exporting files to spec so they slot straight into the client's channel



What we need from you



A strong portfolio or reel showing short-form social/marketing edits, not just long-form

Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro (tell us which)

A solid eye for pacing, cuts on beat, and hook-first editing for social platforms

Reliable turnaround on deadlines — this matters more than hours logged, since there's no fixed schedule

Comfortable taking a written brief and asking clarifying questions rather than guessing

Own editing setup (software licence, sufficient storage/processing power for 4K footage)



Nice to have, not required



Experience editing for automotive, trades, or hospitality clients

Familiarity with working across multiple client brand guidelines at once



How the work is structured



Projects are assigned via ClickUp with a brief, source footage link, and due date

Rate is agreed per project before work starts, starting at $25 AUD and scaling with scope (length, number of revisions, complexity of graphics)



No minimum hours or project volume guaranteed — this is pick-up work based on what's on the production line

To apply



Think you're what we're looking for?



Send a portfolio/reel link, your day-rate or per-project rate expectations, your editing software of choice, and your typical turnaround time for a 60-90 second edit, and your WhatsApp details.

Base Compensation + Performance Incentives Bonuses and Schedule

·      A $100 USD Property Conversion Bonus for each qualified property leads that results in a fully executed, owner-approved Incentive Bonuses are paid only after the placement or lease has been verified.

 

How to Apply

Please provide all of the following: Please note that applications that do not address the requested information may not be considered.

·      Your resume (CV), detailing summary of your relevant work experience.

·      A video introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role. Please provide a Loom or Google Drive link rather than attaching a large video file, be sure to include the following: 

1.        A brief example of the work you have completed and any performance goals you were responsible for, such as call volume, appointment setting, conversion rates, follow-up completion, or data-quality standards.

3.        Your weekly availability and the exact hours you can consistently work in U.S. Central Time.

4.        Confirmation that you have a reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, and quiet workspace.

 

About Company

Growing Shared Housing Company is expanding its housing and community referral network throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth area. We are building a professional, paperless operating system for referral-partner development, property outreach, resident onboarding, and shared-housing administration.

 

About the Role

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented professionals who can help develop referral relationships while keeping our housing operations organized and execution-ready.  experience. You've moderated or been active in a real server.

title: Video Editor
description:
# Part-Time Video Editor (Remote) – Short Form Content for Fitness Brand



## About Us



We are **Ignite Training Co**, a rapidly growing face-to-face personal training business based in Adelaide, Australia. We currently work with over 100 clients across two gym locations and create regular content for Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube.



We're looking for a talented and reliable video editor to help us scale our content output and create engaging videos that educate, entertain and generate leads.



## About The Role



This is a remote part-time position with flexible hours.



You will primarily be editing:



* Instagram Reels

* TikToks

*
 videos

* Client transformation videos

* Educational fitness content

* Behind-the-scenes business content

* Promotional videos and advertisements



Most videos will be short-form content between 15 and 90 seconds.



## Responsibilities



* Edit short-form videos with engaging pacing and storytelling.

* Add captions, transitions, zooms and sound effects where appropriate.

* Source B-roll footage when required.

* Create strong hooks within the first 3 seconds of videos.

* Follow brand guidelines and editing style examples.

* Deliver videos within agreed turnaround times.

* Organise project files and maintain communication regarding progress.



## Requirements



* Previous experience editing short-form social media content.

* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, 
 and
 video trends.

* Proficiency with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar software.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Reliable internet connection.

* Ability to take feedback and implement revisions quickly.

* Attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work.



## Bonus Points If You Have Experience With



* Fitness industry content.

* YouTube editing.

* Motion graphics.

* Thumbnail creation.

* Graphic design.

* AI editing tools and workflows.



## Hours & Pay



* Approximately 10-20 hours per week initially.

* Opportunity to increase hours as we grow.

* Salary negotiable based on experience and skill level.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume.

2. Links to your best editing work (especially short-form content).

3. Your preferred hourly rate in USD.

4. The software you use for editing.

5. The word **"IGNITE"** at the start of your application so we know you read the entire job description.

6. A short 1-2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a good fit for the role.



We are looking for someone long-term who wants to grow with our business and become an important part of our team.
